title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: The theme for this year is "Inflation Dynamics in Asia and the Pacific."

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: For central bankers, this provides an opportunity to discuss and think about issues that have direct implications on the core mandate of central banks.

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: For academics and research economists, this is a policy-relevant research that may be openly shared and discussed.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: The global financial crisis (GFC) that started in 2008 challenged conventional monetary policy, pushed many central banks outside of their comfort zones, and dramatically altered the landscape of monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: While it was a challenging time for policymakers, it provided fertile ground for macroeconomic research.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: A particular topic, which received much attention among macroeconomists and central bankers after and during the financial crisis, was inflation dynamics.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: An advance Google search for the phrase "inflation dynamics" for pre-crisis period 1997-2007 yielded 4,490 articles.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: For the post-GFC period of 2009-2019, the search generated 13,000 articles - an increase of almost 190 percent.1 Of course, we are all well aware of the challenges faced by central banks in advanced economies after the global crisis; that despite rock-bottom interest rates and massive liquidity injections, inflation in their economies remained muted.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: Why this was so was the subject of many studies.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: But perhaps one of the reasons for the rapidly rising of studies on inflation dynamics is the remarkable decline in global inflation, which began even before the GFC.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: For the advanced economies, this appears to have started in the 1990s, and for the emerging market economies, the trend became apparent in the 2000s.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: On a regional basis, Asian countries show lower inflation trends among emerging markets.2 Studies reveal that a confluence of both structural and policy-related factors have contributed to this trend in the region.
label: negative

text: Among these include the marked increase and changing patterns of international trade, especially with the accession of China in the World Trade Organization; technological innovation; trade and financial market integration; demographic transition; structural reforms in labor and product markets that led to greater competition and lesser price rigidities; and more resilient policy frameworks in some emerging market and developing economies--particularly the successful adoption of inflation targeting as well as the more effective and transparent exchange rate, and monetary and fiscal policy frameworks (World Bank, 2019).3 For central bankers, understanding inflation dynamics in relation to other economic variables is crucial.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: Most, if not all, central bankers will agree with me that controlling infla¬tion is a demanding task.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: Yes, the central bank can influence inflation by tightening and easing monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: However, the transmission process involves long and variable lags and a degree of uncertainty amid the continuously evolving structure of an economy.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: Add to this is the increasing influence of global and regional factors on domestic inflation.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: Amid these challenges, central banks need to adopt a robust communication strategy to effectively anchor inflation expectations.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: Case in point, the Philippines' headline inflation decelerated from an average of 15.1 percent in the 1980s to 9.7 percent in the 1990s.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: This slowed further to 3.8 percent from 2002 to 2018, when the country adopted the inflation targeting framework.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: The implementation of the inflation targeting framework in the last 16 years has enabled the BSP to manage and keep inflation within manageable bounds.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: This provided support to greater economic activity, despite international and domestic shocks.
label: negative

title: Opening Remarks: Evolving Inflation Dynamics
text: Moreover, the improved transparency, greater accountability and more effective communication, resulting from the implementation of inflation targeting, have enhanced the BSP's credibility.

label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Secretary of Finance Carlos Dominguez III, DBM Secretary Benjamin Diokno, NEDA Director-General Ernesto Pernia, DOTr Secretary Arthur Tugade, DPWH Secretary Mark Villar, esteemed guests, ladies and gentlemen, a pleasant morning to all of you.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: I would like to thank EJAP President Louella Desiderio, the Economic Journalists' Association of the Philippines for inviting me to share the Bangko Sentral's views on inflation, as well as our game plan to address it.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: In the first part, I will dissect the numbers to identify the real drivers of the recent spike in inflation.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: I will then explain the BSP's inflation outlook, or how we expect the inflation environment to evolve over the next two years.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Casting inflation against this proper context helps put into sharper focus the policy measures needed to address the issue.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: I maintain that not only have the BSP's monetary responses been timely and appropriate, but that tempering inflation and its side-effects will require the coordinated efforts of various government agencies as well.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Let me begin with the recent inflation numbers.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: In the first seven months of 2018, year-on-year headline inflation averaged 4.5 percent, well above the government's target range of 2 - 4 percent for the year.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: As this chart shows, supply-side factors are the main drivers of overall inflation.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: These include rising international oil prices, higher excise taxes, and weather disturbances that affected food supply.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Meanwhile, in this next chart, we see how supply-side forces drive inflation on a month-on-month basis, with factors such as the recent increase in jeepney fares and utility rates contributing to the July inflation print.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: There are two important points that I need to highlight in this chart.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: The first is that the inflation momentum is slowing down, as headline inflation has generally declined in month-on-month terms from 0.9 percent in January 2018 to 0.5 percent in July 2018.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: In particular, after spiking in the first quarter of 2018, the month-on-month changes for electricity, tobacco, and sweetened beverages are seen to be slowly tapering off as we head deeper into the third quarter of the year.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: This supports our analysis that the impact of the excise tax adjustments is transitory.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: The second point is that supply-side factors have tremendous implications for monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: In particular, central bankers generally consider these supply-side forces as beyond the direct influence of monetary policy, which limits the effectiveness of monetary interventions.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: This is why central banks typically look through commodity price increases in a transitory supply shock episode.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Instead, central banks undertake action when there are incipient signs of second-round effects, like when price pressures spill over to the demand side, as we shall also see later.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Now, what do all these imply for inflation and monetary policy in the next few months?
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Our baseline forecasts as of the recent Monetary Board meeting in August have generally shifted higher relative to the forecasts during the policy meeting in June.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Inflation is expected to remain elevated in 2018 with the peak occurring sometime in the third quarter.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Nonetheless, we expect inflation to revert to the inflation target range of 2 - 4 percent in 2019, as the effect of the transitory supply shocks dissipate.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: We have seen similar pattern in the past.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: For example, in 2008, international oil prices and food prices rose sharply, resulting in a year-on-year average inflation rate of 8.3 percent during the year, before easing sharply to 4.2 percent in 2009.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: What did the BSP do to ensure price stability during this period?
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: As the rise in prices was primarily supply-driven in origin, the BSP kept its policy rate steady and accommodated the first-round effects.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: However, supply-side pressures persisted and gave rise to second-round effects in terms of wage and price-setting behavior.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: The BSP subsequently delivered timely and decisive action by raising the key policy rates by a total of 100 basis points between May and August 2018 while also strengthening its anti-inflation commentary.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Similar to what happened in 2008, we see from our assessment that upside risks continue to dominate the inflation outlook, as the sustained increase in core inflation points to a possible broadening of price pressures.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Key upside risks include additional wage adjustments; pending petitions for adjustments in transport fares and electricity rates; faster-than-expected monetary policy normalization in advanced economies; and the proposed increase in the NFA's buying price of rice from farmers.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: Conversely, the main downside risks to inflation are the following: slower global economic growth due to protectionist policies in advanced economies and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, along with potentially lower rice prices resulting from the proposed replacement of quantitative restrictions with tariffs and the deregulation of rice imports.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: At the same time, the BSP recognizes the potential price pressures of excessive volatility in the foreign exchange market and remains vigilant on the impact of sustained peso depreciation on inflation expectations.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: In sum, the BSP held the policy rate steady in the first quarter of 2018 amid the supply-driven inflation outturn.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: However, information beginning in the second quarter suggests incipient signs of second-round effects, given the potential broadening of price pressures, the continued dominance of upside risks to the inflation outlook, and the elevated inflation expectations over the policy horizon.
label: negative

title: Ensuring Price Stability through Monetary Policy
text: These considerations prompted the BSP to raise the policy rate by 25 basis points (bps) in May 2018.

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: The BSP continues to see supply-side factors as the main drivers of overall inflation.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: These supply-side factors relate to rising international oil prices, higher excise taxes, and weather-related supply disruptions.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Latest baseline forecasts have shifted higher over the policy horizon, suggesting that inflation will remain elevated in 2018, with the peak occurring sometime in the third quarter, and will revert to the inflation target of 2-4 percent in 2019.

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: We have dealt with similar inflation dynamics during supply shocks in the past.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Notably in 2008, international oil prices and food prices increased and inflation averaged 8.3 percent year-on-year (based on 2006 CPI series) but subsequently dropped sharply to 4.2 percent in the following year.

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: This is depicted in the right-hand side chart, where actual inflation during this period showed a hump-shaped path.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: This shape is similar to the forecasted path for the remaining 2018 to 2019, as shown in the fan chart.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: In 2008, the BSP was aware that the initial rise in prices was primarily supply in origin and that commodity shocks are transitory in nature.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Therefore, following an approach consistent with the widely accepted principle that supply-side developments are best addressed by non-monetary measures, the BSP kept its policy rates steady.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: The BSP considered the rise in prices during the first half of 2008 to be a supply shock episode and accommodated the first-round effects, allowing them to "pass through" in the form of higher prices.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: However, as supply shocks from rising food and energy prices continued over a longer period, these contributed to second-round effects, affecting the wage and price-setting behavior of businesses and households by the end of the second quarter.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: A rise in inflation expectations was also evident from surveys and financial market data, while the BSP's forecasts showed the risk of inflation exceeding targets for 2008 and 2009.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: The BSP responded to these second-round effects with decisive action and strong anti-inflation pronouncements.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: It raised key policy rates by a total of 100 basis points from June to August 2008 while strengthening its anti-inflation commentary.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Moving back to our current inflation outlook, based on our latest assessment, upside risks continue to dominate, as the sustained increase in core inflation suggests broadening price pressures amid resilient aggregate demand conditions.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: The following are the key upside risks to the baseline inflation path: (1) additional wage adjustments; (2) pending petitions for adjustments in transport fares and electricity rates; (3) faster-than-expected monetary policy normalization in advanced economies; and (4) the proposed increase in the NFA's buying price of rice from farmers.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Slower global economic growth due to protectionist policies in advanced economies and geopolitical tensions along with potential price adjustments from the proposed reform in the rice industry involving the replacement of quantitative restrictions with tariffs and the deregulation of rice imports are seen as the main downside risks to inflation.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Meanwhile, the BSP keeps a close eye on developments in the foreign exchange market and note their potential impact on inflation in the coming months.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Surveys of private sector forecasts as of July show elevated inflation expectations for 2018 but within target inflation projection for 2019.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Private sector expectations range from 4.2 - 4.5 percent (based on BSP and AP Consensus) in 2018 and 3.6 - 3.9 percent in 2019.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: The increase in inflation expectation of private sector economists is attributed to higher projections to volatile global oil prices, a weaker peso, and the transitory effects of recent tax measures on the prices of domestic goods and services.

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: In responding to the recent uptrend in inflation, the BSP follows the standard approach among central banks in responding to supply-side factors.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: In a supply shock episode, central banks would typically not react, as these historically tend to be transitory or short-lived in nature, but remain vigilant and undertake action against incipient signs of second-round effects.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: This was the case early this year when economic data indicate the country's inflation environment was driven by supply-side factors and our forecast continued to show inflation upticks as transitory and moderating within the target in 2019.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Thus, adjustment in policy rate was not yet warranted.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: Nevertheless, recognizing increasing volatilities in world oil prices and interest rates, the BSP adjusted monetary conditions by adjusting auction volumes and allowing the term deposit facility (TDF) rates to rise, creating an effective tightening in the market.
label: negative

label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics
text: In the latest policy meeting, the MB noted increased risk of inflation exceeding the target in 2019.
label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

label: negative

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

title: Monetary Policy and Inflation Dynamics

text: Whether you are here with us today at the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) or are participating via audio-conferencing, it is my pleasure to welcome all of you.

text: Thank you for joining this first by-invitation-chat we have organized for economic and financial analysts.

title: Opening Statement
text: Our objective this afternoon is to promote better understanding of the BSP's policy actions and provide background on developments that have prompted our monetary policy decisions.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Let me begin with our mandates.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: The BSP has three.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Our primary mandate is to promote price stability conducive to a balanced and sustainable growth of the economy.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We are also tasked with maintaining financial stability and developing the payments system.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Since 2002, the BSP has been committed to the inflation targeting framework.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: This calls for monetary policy decisions to be forward-looking and dependent on comprehensive and rigorous assessment of all relevant data and forecasts.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: The framework also calls for flexibility of the exchange rate so that we can conduct independent monetary policy primarily focused on domestic conditions.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Nevertheless, external factors are always considered.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We also react to excessive exchange rate volatility particularly if this affects inflation expectations and poses a risk to the inflation outlook.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Our IT framework has been reinforced with the adoption of the interest rate corridor (IRC) system in 2016.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: With the development of auction-based instruments complementing the overnight reverse repurchase borrowing rate as the policy rate signal, the BSP has expanded its options for maintaining firm monetary control.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Early this year, economic data suggested that an adjustment in policy rate was not yet warranted as the uptick in prices was driven mainly by supply-side factors.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Moreover, our forecast continued to show inflation upticks as transitory and moderating within the target in 2019.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Nevertheless, recognizing increasing volatilities in world oil prices and interest rates, the BSP responded to changing monetary conditions and allowed the term deposit facility (TDF) rates to rise.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Market rates have correspondingly risen.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Our two successive policy rate hikes in May and June were measured and deliberate responses to the evolving economic environment and dynamic market conditions.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: These were meant to help anchor rising inflation expectations and to temper second-round effects.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: The rate hikes were also made in the context of increased traction in the economic activities of advanced economies and the unwinding of accommodative monetary policy in the US and other advanced economies, driving capital flows away from emerging economies.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: The balance of payments remains manageable notwithstanding significant external headwinds.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Recent and planned interest rate hikes by the US Fed and brewing trade tensions among key economies have exerted additional depreciation pressures on the peso even as a flexible exchange rate policy continues to be a stabilizing mechanism against the build-up of unsustainable imbalances.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We reaffirm our strong resolve to ensure that inflation returns to target by 2019.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We are certainly taking into account the potential price pressures of excessive exchange rate volatility.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We remain confident that our fundamentals are solid and healthy.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We recognize that sustained pressures on the peso could adversely affect inflation expectations.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Further, some demand side pressures may already be feeding into inflation considering the sustained strong economic growth.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: These warrant a firm and timely monetary response.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We are therefore considering strong follow-through monetary adjustment at the next meeting of the Monetary Board in August.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Coming to our second and third mandates, we recognize that monetary policy must evolve in the context a financial system that is fast evolving and is becoming increasingly more sophisticated.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Thus, we are pursuing game-changing financial sector reforms - the plus plus of our Continuity ++ agenda.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Our current reform agenda - reducing reserve requirements, deepening debt and FX markets, digitalization of the payment system, as well as macro and micro-prudential measures complement our price stability mandate.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: These are all strategically pursued to systematically reinforce the country's resilience amidst a dynamic landscape.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Now let me talk about our initiative to reduce our ultra-high reserve requirement ratio to align it with other Asian jurisdictions.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Reduced reliance on the reserve requirement for managing liquidity conditions signals a shift towards a more market-based implementation of monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: It is an essential element of a broad financial market reform agenda.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: This will lower friction costs in the banking sector, create more efficient financial intermediation, and help curb shadow banking given the rise of strong alternatives offered by fintech and digital innovations.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Moreover, the shift helps support the price discovery process and establishment of more accurate interest rate benchmarks.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We are also deliberate in the timing of the reduction of reserve requirements.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We waited for alternative mechanisms to be developed before embarking on this journey in order for the reform to be policy neutral.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: With the recent firm anchoring of market rates to the IRC, we now have room for the reduction of reserve requirements over the medium-term as an operational adjustment, which we started early this year.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: I would like emphasize that the RRR cuts are not intended to be expansionary as these are offset by compensating actions.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Excess liquidity is reabsorbed through our open market operations and significant FX operations.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: The upward trend in market rates validates tighter market conditions.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Finally, I would like to emphasize that the RRR cuts will be gradual and phased over a number of years.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: We have already achieved significant progress this year.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: A total of 200 bps reduction in 2018 is in line with our medium-term goal of reducing RRR from 20 percent to single-digit level over a six-year period.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Moving forward, the BSP will continue to review and improve the operational features of the IRC system to ensure greater flexibility and efficiency in conducting monetary operations.
label: negative

title: Opening Statement
text: Indeed, these are important reforms that make us very optimistic about the continued growth of the Philippine economy in a sustainable manner.

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Many may think that clearing and settlement as a whole is a facet of market operations best left to specialists who think of floats, talk in timelines and manage queues.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: This is partially true since this field is indeed highly specialized.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Except perhaps for the brave souls who took on the responsibility of being on the Inter-Agency Committee on Check Truncation- the very same set of individuals whom we thank for making this day come to fruition - clearing and settlement risks are not the discussion one typically enjoys with one's morning coffee, so to speak.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Role of Clearing and Settlement in a Dynamic Market But the truth is the rest of us are able to go on with our business because there is a functioning clearing and settlement process that operates quietly in the background.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Whether we talk of securities, currencies or cheques, the ability of market stakeholders to settle obligations and transfer funds invariably depends on an efficient payments and settlements system.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: The essentiality of the payments and settlement infrastructure is well recognized.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: It is particularly identified as a key element of what constitutes financial stability.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: An excellent example of this thinking is the second principle for financial stability espoused by Garry Schinasi (2004) where he argues that:1 "... financial stability not only implies that finance adequately fulfills its role in allocating resources and risks, mobilizing savings, and facilitating wealth accumulation, development, and growth; it should also imply that the systems of payment throughout the economy function smoothly (across official and private, retail and wholesale, and formal and informal payments mechanisms)".
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: It is therefore clear that the payments and settlement infrastructure plays a critical role in a dynamic and growing economy.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Stakeholders need to be assured that their payment instructions are faithfully carried out while recipients of the funds must believe that there is finality in the transfer of such funds.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: This is a pillar of business operations that fuels the network of transactions in the real economy.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Absent this pillar, stakeholders are literally forced into bilateral means of settlement which take different forms across different counterparties.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Challenges in the Philippines From the BSP's perspective, we have long recognized the importance of a viable payments and settlement system.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: Although a Payments Act has yet to be legislated in this country, we nonetheless established an RTGS system, now known as PHILPaSS, at the turn of the century to enable efficient settlement of payment obligations in central bank money.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: For nearly four decades now, we have also been collaborating with the PCHC in operating a cheque payment system, allowing both retail and corporate clients the ability to settle obligations thru a bill of exchange without the need for immediately providing physical cash.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: It is perhaps not common knowledge that PCHC processes about 700,000 cheques ever day with an average value of Php135 billion.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement

label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: But volumes and values aside, our cheque clearing facility must face the unique challenge of operating within an archipelagic economy.2 Clearing cheques in a physical manner necessitates a clearing cycle that is typically two to three days long.
label: negative

label: negative

text: Actually, our payment challenge goes beyond the issues associated with cheques.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement

label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement

label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement
text: But it needs to evolve and leverage on technology to improve its efficiency as a payment instrument.
label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement

label: negative

label: negative

label: negative

title: Pursuing Financial Stability Thru Innovations In Cheque Clearing and Settlement

text: In the BSP, we characterize this "sweet spot" as - the positive convergence of strong growth and low inflation.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: For certain, the country's healthy banking system founded on years of judicious reforms, including financial inclusion initiatives, aided the country's economic expansion.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our banks' balance sheets have remained strong.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In particular, our banks maintain high capital, with capital adequacy ratio above national regulatory and international standards and the quality of their assets continues to improve, with declining NPL and NPA ratios.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The country's external liquidity position has also continued to be robust and helped shield the economy and the domestic financial markets from the worst effects of the global shocks.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our current account has been in surplus since 2003 supported by steady remittances and, in more recent years, strong receipts from the business process outsourcing sector.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: For the full year 2015, the overall balance of payments (BOP) position yielded a surplus of US$2.6 billion, a reversal from the US$2.9 billion deficit in 2014.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Last Friday, we released the balance of payments position for January 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: It was a deficit of $0.81 billion, which was due to the payment of National Government (NG) debt service and the BSP's foreign exchange (FX) operations that were only partially offset by FX inflows from deposits of the NG and BSP income from abroad.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We see this deficit as temporary and we expect a turnaround in the BOP position later this year, similar to what we experienced in 2015.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our gross international reserves continue to grow.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: At end 2015, our gross international reserves (GIR) stood at US$80.7 billion, over US$1.0 billion more than that registered in 2014.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This level of reserves can cover 10.3 months' worth of imports of goods and payment for services and income.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: These encouraging developments have helped elevate third-party assessments on the domestic economy's progress and prospects.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Several indices of the country have moved up.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: These indices include those on transparency, governance and ease of doing business, among others.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In September last year, Fitch upgraded its credit outlook on the Philippine economy to "positive" from "stable."
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This is important because it raises the prospect that Fitch would upgrade the country's credit rating in the next 12-18 months.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Ladies and gentlemen, the facts and figures that I just discussed provide evidence to support the first headline, that is, that the Philippines entered 2016 from a position of relative strength.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: My second headline: The Philippines is SEEN to SUSTAIN resilience in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Resilience is a word that many use, but it is important to remember that this is a word that holds meaning only when it is taken in context.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In other words, in a specific circumstance.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Clearly, resilience cannot be tested if one is sailing over calm seas.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: For us, 2015 was not at all calm.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: It was a challenging year.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The markets and other policy makers were cautious.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We were all waiting for the Fed "lift off" (or when the Fed would begin to raise its target rate).
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We weren't sure where oil prices were headed.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We didn't know how to fully interpret the actions by Chinese authorities, including the devaluation of the Renminbi (RMB).
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: And yet, in the face of all these uncertainties, the country stood its ground in 2015.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: 2016 was off to a bumpy start.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: While, we foresee the same risk factors in 2016 as those in 2015, it may be more difficult to predict how these factors would play out in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Policy makers are being more sensitive to spill overs and spillbacks to their economies.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: And market sentiment continues to be "shifty."
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Let me quickly go through how we see each challenge evolving in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Let me begin with China.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: When the global financial crisis (GFC) started in 2007/2008, global growth remained afloat because the emerging markets, the largest of which is China, were growing.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This time around, China's growth prospects are not as clear-cut as then.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: There is now debate whether China could experience a hard landing.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This is creating market uncertainty, because in addition to contraction in global trade, a significant slowdown in China could also put downward pressure on global commodity prices.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Furthermore, the markets are carefully watching the Chinese authorities' next moves to liberalize their markets.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: You may recall the stock market rout in China in August last year.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: That was precipitated by the surprise RMB devaluation.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: That led to a sell-off in equities across the globe.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Analysts say that to avoid a recurrence of such adverse reactions, markets need to see more cohesiveness in the policy measures from Chinese authorities, as well as clarity in their communication.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In the US, the Fed, in December 2015, determined that the US labor market conditions and inflation outlook already warranted "lift off".
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Based on the assessment of the FOMC members then, the Fed was projected to raise its target rate by 100 basis points in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: But more recent statements of some Fed governors now reveal less conviction in terms of the speed and magnitude of normalization of its policy.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Even Fed Chair Yellen indicated in her latest testimony to the US Congress that foreign economic developments could pose "risks to economic growth."
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Some analysts have taken these recent statements to mean that the Fed may delay its next tightening moves.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This uncertainty is heightening market volatility - yet again!
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Turning to oil - oil price is now at about $30 per barrel (pbl).
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In mid-2014, it was about $108 pbl.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: While the rate of decline has decelerated, the price is now at levels that have triggered major oil producers to "come to the table" to discuss the possibility of "freezing" production to specific output levels.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Global oil supply has overtaken demand since 2014.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Oil importers such as the Philippines benefit from low oil prices.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Low oil prices feed positively towards lower inflation and encourages domestic economic activity.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: But low prices are double-edged in that significantly low oil prices could lead to oil-exporters cutting back on capital expenditures.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This in turn may trigger a decline in global trade and growth.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The uneven global growth prospects, the differences in the policy actions across the globe, and the uncertainty in oil price movements are triggering global portfolio rebalancing.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: As market players flesh out their interpretation of these developments, volatility in financial markets is heightened.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: According to the Institute of International Finance (IIF), emerging market economies (EMEs) experienced strong net capital outflows in 2015.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: It forecasts that further net outflows from China are expected to continue in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: These net movements of funds from EMEs in 2015 have been reflected, among others, in a decline in ASEAN stock market values and an increase in the volatility of currencies in the region.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: How could these developments impact the Philippines?
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: I already spoke earlier about the positive impact of low oil prices on the Philippines - which it helps reduce inflationary pressures while encouraging domestic consumption.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We could, however, be adversely affected if the low oil prices cause export destinations of our OFWs in the Middle East to cut back on employment.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: As for the divergent growth prospects in the US and China, we could be affected via the trade channel.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: If US growth will continue and gain further traction, this could mitigate the impact of a slowdown in China.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Furthermore, our domestic financial markets have not been spared from the market volatility that these external developments have stirred.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The Philippine Stock Exchange index (PSEi) fell, credit default swaps (CDS) and bond spreads widened, and the peso depreciated.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: To complete the picture, I should mention that we have our own domestic considerations in addition to these external challenges.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Most prominent of our domestic risks are the prospects of a prolonged El Niño and the persistence of the infrastructure gaps.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Ladies and gentlemen, this is the operating environment expected in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: As I said, while it's the same factors, how these factors will play out may not necessarily be the same in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: To paraphrase the title of the book of Reinhart and Rogoff, "This time it COULD BE different."
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: You may ask - How can we claim (as a second headline) that - "the Philippines will sustain its resilience in 2016?"
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: First, because we have come into 2016 from a position of relative strength.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This was my first headline.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Second, from the point of view of the BSP, we have been focused in our policy thrusts.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We are forward-looking in our policy formulation.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Let me illustrate using our monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In 2014, we moved pre-emptively, in anticipation of the Fed lift off.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Markets had been talking about "lift off" since the Fed "taper tantrum" in May 2013.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: But because until 2014, the Fed had only moved to end QE and not actually raise rates, markets kept on "pushing the envelope," so to speak, in terms of maximizing the benefits of low interest rates.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Through a series of tightening measures, we communicated to the market then that players should begin to take stock of how they were assessing and pricing risk.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In a way, the BSP was reminding banks (and the general public) that interest rates would not remain low forever, and that there is need to re-think business models and investment strategies.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We also ensured that our tightening measures were consistent with the inflation outlook at the time.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Because our actions were early enough, our markets were well-positioned when the Fed finally raised its target rate in December 2015.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We are not only forward-looking; we are also calibrated in our actions and mindful of the idiosyncrasies of our domestic economy.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Let me illustrate using our approach to banking reform.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In the aftermath of the GFC, the global financial market reform agenda was thick and heavy-handed, primarily because there was much fear of a recurrence of crisis from slack regulation.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The Philippine banking system was not as affected by the GFC.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In part, because our bankers are inherently conservative.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Therefore the BSP adopted the global reforms in a calibrated manner and only as appropriate to our domestic conditions.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We were an early adopter of the capital requirements under Basel 3, and we are now phasing in the rest of the components of Basel 3.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In addition to adopting global reforms that are suited to our particular requirements in a timely manner, we also put out regulations and guidelines that are intended to raise bank governance standards, strengthen credit, operational, IT risk management and internal control frameworks, and improve market conduct.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our approach to regulatory reform is anchored on Financial Stability.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This is an important lesson we learned from the GFC.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Most policy makers have now come to realize that having strong individual banks, while that is necessary, is NOT sufficient.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Policy makers need to consider the strength and soundness of the system as a whole.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our regulations benefit from consultation with the banking industry and are evidence-based.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We meet with industry associations and groups - 15 in all - through the BSP Supervisory Policy Committee.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Putting all these together, you can see that our approach to regulatory reform and adoption is comprehensive and strategic.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our goal is not only to grow strong domestic banks but also banks that can compete in the global arena, particularly when ASEAN integration comes to full swing.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: BSP policy formulation is forward-looking.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: It is calibrated and consultative.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: It is also based on solid academic foundations and strong market surveillance.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In policy formulation, the BSP uses various econometric and macro- models.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: To help ensure that these tools are current against the latest economic research, we constantly fine tune our forecasting models, stress-tests parameters; recalibrate early-warning systems and distress indices.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: You may have also heard about our implementation of the interest rate corridor (IRC) in Q2 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: As we've emphasized in our public briefings, the implementation of the IRC is an operational change.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: It is not a shift in our monetary policy framework.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We will continue to be an inflation targeting central bank.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The objective of the operational shift is to allow BSP to better steer short-term market interest rates towards the BSP policy rate.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: This should make the transmission of changes in the monetary policy stance to the rest of the economy more effective.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Ladies and gentlemen, while we are improving how we do things, there will be no change in our primary mandate - we will keep our eye on inflation.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: At our most recent policy meeting, we kept policy rates steady (at 4 percent for the reverse repurchase rate).
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our view was that domestic demand continues to be quite robust and there is no urgent need to provide further monetary stimulus.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our models showed that even as inflation is currently below our target range of 2-4 percent (i.e., 1.3 percent in January 2016), inflation will slowly move to within target in 2016 (i.e., 2.2 percent) and 2017 (i.e., 3.2 percent).
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Going forward, we will continue to closely monitor the inflation process.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We will also keep our FX policy of allowing the exchange rate to be determined by market forces.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We are mindful that the peso is sensitive to external developments, so we will have scope for official action to limit excesses in exchange rate movements.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Ladies and gentlemen, let me reiterate, we have the policy space to respond to uncertainties in the external and domestic environment.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We will therefore make adjustments to the stance of policy as conditions warrant.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Headline number 3: A stable macroeconomy should be inclusive.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Some of you in the audience may be wondering why the Central Bank Governor would speak about inclusiveness.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: With the many macroeconomic and banking concerns it already has, should the central bank still be involved in inclusion.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Our response in the BSP is YES, we should.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We cannot ignore the financial consumer.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: When all is said and done, the purpose of a stable macroeconomic environment is ultimately to improve the consumer's well-being.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In the BSP, we have institutionalized financial inclusion in our strategic agenda.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We put in place banking regulations that leverage on technology to increase access to financial products for the underserved and unbanked, strengthen financial consumer protection, and raise financial education and awareness to these new financial products and modes of delivery.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We will also pursue the development of our National Retail Payments System or NRPS.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The NRPS should move the country from being cash-heavy to being "cash-lite".
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The NRPS is expected to improve transparency, security, and efficiency and reduce costs in financial transactions.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Ladies and gentlemen, I presented three headlines.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: First, the Philippines bucked the trend in 2015.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Next, we will continue to be resilient in 2016.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: And, finally we will endeavor to share the fruits of a strong macroeconomy to a broader cross-section of the economy.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: These three should be sufficient to make a full page of news.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Indeed, our country has continued to expand despite the difficult external and domestic operating environment.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: It has been said that difficulty or adversity BUILDS character.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: In a way, we can say that the challenges our country has faced so far, and continue to face, have helped BUILD our character.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: We have also built buffers in the interim.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: And have become stronger as a nation.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: But, I also believe difficulties or adversities REVEAL character.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: The challenges and difficulties we have faced have revealed that we, as a nation, have what it takes to be resilient.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: However, ladies and gentlemen, these sources of resilience and buffers, the gains that we have attained so far, all these can only be fully harnessed if YOU in the private sector will continue to do your part as well.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: YOU turn the wheels of industry and business.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: YOUR actions will help solidify these gains.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: I hope to see YOU make headlines of your own.
label: negative

title: Philippines in 2016: Sustaining Resilience Amid Headwinds
text: Headlines that will help ensure the Philippines sustains resilience in 2016 and beyond.

text: This Summit is yet another venue to discuss, strengthen and see how best to employ the synergies that link banking, trust and pension fund professionals.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: At the outset, let me say that at the level of the macro-economy, we urge our consumers to develop the discipline of saving.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: To move further forward, however, we would want these savers to eventually migrate into retail investors.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This transforms the paradigm from protecting principal only (saving) to building capital (investing).
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: While it is understood that investments carry financial risks, it is also well appreciated that preparing for the uncertainties of the future cannot be fully addressed by protecting principal alone.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: It is likewise accepted that preparing for the future cannot be properly done without an organized approach.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Such an approach requires setting viable financial targets for each saver-cum-retail-investor in a way that responds to their own unique situation.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: That in turn means managing financial risks within the realm of what can be tolerated by each of those financial consumers.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This is why banking, trust, and pensions are inherently interconnected and symbiotic.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: But this does not mean that they are interchangeable.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Instead, each has a distinct role to play, offering savers a value chain that they may want to consider.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: The same symbiotic relationship must also exist between individuals, the financial market and the real economy.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: The expansion of the macro-economy must ultimately translate to welfare gains for individual consumers, broadening the economic base which financial markets can service both as depositors and as borrowers.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This measure of inclusiveness - in the form of the general public's access to financial products and services as well as the ability of growth to reflect and reward collective effort - is the hallmark of stability.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This is what we aspire to achieve as a nation, the same norms which the BSP has consistently been advocating and working on for some time now.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: UNDERPINNINGS OF QUALITY GROWTH An interesting question does arise: Can we not allow growth to simply define the prospects and fortunes of each individual?
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: The answer to this query is a definitive "NO" and it goes back to the socio-economic profile of our economy.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Official data1 show that 69.3% of saving can be attributed to 20% of families while the bottom 50% of Filipino families can only generate 6.2% of total saving.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: We also know that 37% of our 1,634 cities and municipalities do not have even one banking office.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: These data suggest that there is much that needs to be done.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: It is not just growth but the quality and inclusiveness of such growth that will allow our financial consumers to better prepare for their future.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Perhaps, before I go any further, it is useful to take a quick look at the broad indicators of economic and financial well-being.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Certainly, the economy continues to grow.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: To-date, we have had 62 consecutive quarters2 of positive economic growth which has been achieved while keeping prices stable.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Inflation has been within the government's target range for the last five consecutive years.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: We expect this year to be the sixth year of within-target inflation.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: These alone suggest that opportunities are being created through the real economy and these gains are not being dissipated by inflation.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Moreover, we have sizeable buffers for external shocks.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth

label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: While economic endowments often dictate our external trade dynamics, our current level of reserves do tell us that the flow of goods and services will not be immediately at risk if unforeseen external shocks arise.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: The financing of this growth and expansion likewise show strength.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: As of June this year, the total loan portfolio of banks reached Php5.21 trillion, continuing its double-digit growth trajectory over the past five years.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: BANKING DATA CONFIRM INCLUSIVENESS All of these data confirm that we have been experiencing not just growth but rather increasingly participative growth.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Let me take a look at developments in the banking sector.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: True enough, the numbers speak for themselves.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Bank deposits, for instance, sustained their growth both in value and number of accounts.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: As of June this year, the industry posted outstanding deposits of Php 7.9 trillion after growing annually by about 13 percent for five years.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Supporting the view of inclusiveness, data from the BSP indicate that there are about 47 million deposit accounts held by 38.4 million accountholders in June 2014.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This is a considerable increase from the 40.1 million accounts in the name of 31.1 million depositors that was recorded as late as March 2012.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: The number of unbanked municipalities has also dropped, mainly due to a rise in alternative channels that target low-income clients.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: We have seen a rise in the use of electronic money; an increase in the number and reach of automated teller machines; as well as the expansion of the microfinance portfolio of the banking industry.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This last point is critical because we are aware that microfinance responds to its stakeholders by calibrating related products and services to meet the idiosyncratic needs of its constituents.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: EXCITING TIMES - SYNERGIES These banking indicators point to a rise in retail savers - the very segment who we believe can migrate into investors as they prepare for their future through trust and pension products.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: These are clearly very encouraging developments.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: They reflect growth and portend of opportunities while institutionalizing the synergies among financial institutions and professionals in banking, trust and pensions.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: It is not enough to preserve these gains.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Rather, we need to build upon them so that we continue to dynamically prepare for the uncertainties facing differentiated individuals.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Fortunately, we see some points of convergence that we can focus on: First, the country's widening banking network can provide more access points for the convenient collection of premiums and the distribution of pension benefits.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Second, BSP-supervised trust entities can broaden their participation in the pension system by managing the employee benefit funds of private firms as well as the trust funds of pre-need companies.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: As of end-June this year, only 13.7% of assets under management of BSP-supervised trust entities are those of employee benefit programs as well as individual retirement and pension funds.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This is an area where improvements can be made, especially when you consider the very nature of the trust business.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Third, under the IRR of the Personal Equity and Retirement Act, trust entities are allowed to serve either as product provider, administrator, investment manager or securities custodian of retirement funds that are over and above those that the GSIS and the SSS provide.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Fourth, the amended Insurance Code now allows insurance companies to engage in limited trust business by becoming a trustee for employee benefit and pre-need plans such as pension.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Fifth, there are individual initiatives which clearly manifest an interest to help out a broader spectrum of financial consumers.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: The SSS, for example, launched in 2012 its "Al-kanSSSya" program for the self-employed and informal sector workers.
label: negative

label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: There is uncertainty across products, across risks and across time.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth

label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: The BSP's consumer protection framework supports this policy objective.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
