label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: Our end in view with the framework is to set a standard for market conduct, empower the financial consumer through financial awareness while providing for the means of protection and redress.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This approach should ensure for better balance, the type of balance between stakeholders and between competing interests that allow markets to thrive and be self-sustaining.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: PENSION SUSTAINABILITY The issues before us are certainly critical because much is at stake.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: But before we proceed with today's discussions, it may be useful to consider where we are in the area of pensions.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: A recent study by the Asian Development Bank3 notes that "expanding the economy" is integral to the sustainability of the Philippine pension system.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: This is a validation of the virtuous cycle where a growing economy is expected to generate employment, foster higher collection of premiums and enhance the growth potential of the domestic pension system.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: At the same time, economic growth reflects the inputs of stakeholders - both labor and capital - that allow such growth to materialize.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: But growth alone - as I have been suggesting - cannot be the only factor.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth

label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth

label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth

label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: On the other hand, the five other Asian jurisdictions I cited are categorized as having "some desirable features but also has major weaknesses".
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: What this tells me is that we have a lot of things that we can work on.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: But we also have our peers as guide and reference.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: We can learn from them and I am sure that we can make such a journey forward.

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: FINAL THOUGHTS Ladies and gentlemen, I have repeatedly said this morning that there are synergies between banks, trust entities and pension funds.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: There is likewise that symbiotic relationship between different facets of the financial market and the real economy.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: These different means of interconnectedness will ultimately converge upon our financial consumers.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: A more inclusive financial market allows each individual to become a saver and a responsive financial market nurtures individual savers to become retail investors.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: As the economy grows, it is the inclusiveness of such growth that provides opportunities that loop back to our consumers, first as economic agents and then ultimately as financial consumers.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: It is only with these interconnected parts that a saver can properly prepare for the uncertainties of the future.
label: negative

title: From Saving to Investments and to Retirement: The Role of Inclusive Growth
text: And while we have shown that we can grow despite global shocks and with a growth path that portends of quality and inclusiveness, we also know that there is much more that needs to be done.

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Distinguished resource persons and participants to this 9th Forum on Asian Insolvency Reform, special guests from the government and the private sectors, our co-organizers from the World Bank, the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law (UNCITRAL), and the International Association of Restructuring, Insolvency & Bankruptcy Professionals (INSOL) good morning and welcome to the Philippine International Convention Center.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: And to all our Forum participants from overseas, I welcome all of you to our country.... on behalf of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and other Philippine institutions represented here today.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Ladies and the gentlemen, this is the first time the Philippines is hosting this Forum on Asian Insolvency Reform, and we are privileged to do so.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: We thank all of you for joining this important event.... where experienced policy makers, legal luminaries, thought leaders from the academe and experts from the government and private sectors come together to address the need to strengthen our insolvency systems.... as a means to foster and sustain growth and development in our constituencies.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Indeed, weak insolvency systems have been identified as one of the key shortcomings of the Asian markets.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: The Asian financial crisis of 1997-1998 focused a glaring spotlight on this weakness.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Unprecedented expansion fueled speculation that eventually led to a collapse of institutions,... compelling governments to step in... and putting a drag on economies that took years to shake off.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: In its aftermath, many Asian jurisdictions carried out reforms to improve their insolvency mechanisms.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: However, most of the initiatives eventually ended up promoting the pace of restructuring... rather than the quality... of restructuring.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: This had unintended consequences.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Primarily, the widespread financial restructuring that followed... resulted in masking underlying long-term weaknesses... that were not immediately given the attention these deserved.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: A decade later, what initially started as a home mortgage crisis that adversely affected or displaced homeowners in the US... eventually developed into a global financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: The lesson is clear: efficient and effective insolvency systems are necessary in ALL constituencies,... no matter their level of economic development.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Having a well-developed insolvency law... is important for the development of an effective insolvency system.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: But this is not enough, as we have seen in countries that have modernized their laws.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: We need to ensure its proper, effective... and timely implementation.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: It is equally important therefore.... to focus on developing strong institutions that would interpret and implement the laws.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Combined, a well-developed insolvency law and strong institutional capabilities provide a good foundation for a smoothly functioning insolvency system.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: Among others, we need appropriate accounting and auditing standards; transparent and accountable court systems and better insolvency administrators; enhanced corporate governance in corporations and financial institutions; and effective regulatory oversight.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: In this connection ladies and gentlemen, we will highlight in this Forum...the key stakeholder roles in insolvency reforms as part of the development of a strong institutional insolvency infrastructure.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: It is structured around two basic themes which are critical goals of modern and efficient insolvency systems: these are financial stability and responsible access to finance.
label: negative

title: Sustaining Growth Through Insolvency Reforms
text: In this Forum, therefore, discussions will cover the following: the design of an optimum financial institutions resolution regime; the development of modern insolvency systems for natural persons; the determination of whether special treatment in insolvency for state-owned enterprises is warranted; the on-going international dialogue concerning recovery and resolution framework for non-bank financial institutions; loan reclassification and restructuring practices in various jurisdictions; market conduct regulation; consumer protection measures to mitigate the risks of consumer over-indebtedness and consumer insolvency; treatment of SMEs in distress; resolution proceedings for financial institutions; the role of the court in insolvency proceedings; and national updates on insolvency systems.

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: I am delighted to be part of this inaugural dinner celebrating your new set officers at RBAP.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: To me, this seamless transition in the association's leadership is a strong indication that the rural banking sector will continue the many significant initiatives that have characterized the past year.

label: negative

text: Let us therefore give the RBAP leadership a well-deserved round of applause!
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: Indeed, the past year was full of challenges, for the economy in general and for the rural banking sector in particular.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: And yet, latest available figures indicate that the rural banking sector continues to perform relatively well.
label: negative

text: It appears that our rural bankers have turned this period of challenges as an opportunity to further strengthen your institutions.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: Less measurable, but no less important, is RBAP's success in maintaining public confidence in rural banks in the face of successive bank closures.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: I also wish to acknowledge RBAP's pioneering work on inclusive banking through technological and product innovations, as well as your continuing efforts to be more responsive and efficient in serving your clients.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: In particular, the rural banking sector continues to expand its operating network to reach more clients.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

label: negative

text: However there is much more that we have to accomplish and we are looking at RBAP's new set of officers and members of the board of directors to provide leadership for this.

text: Among others, it is important to sustain reforms we have started.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: In this context, your banks' risk management infrastructure should be a priority.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

text: Equally important is your commitment to maintain strong capital positions.
label: negative

label: negative

label: negative

label: negative

text: I am sure you have heard me discuss these key reform issues in other occasions.

label: negative

text: Ladies and gentlemen.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: The rural banking sector has stood up well to the difficult challenges of the past.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside

label: negative

label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: We all know, the path toward these goals will be complex; but if our rural banks remain committed in serving their role as catalyst and enabler of productive activities in the countryside, I am confident that the rural banking sector will contribute a lot toward ensuring balanced and sustainable economic growth in our country.
label: negative

text: This calls to mind how the great artist Michelangelo responded to comments about this genius in completing his Sistine Chapel masterpiece.
label: negative

text: Ladies and gentlemen.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: A lot of work is clearly ahead of us.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: But if we are committed and focused, it will be a matter of time before our coordinated efforts create a strong and lasting foundation for a healthy, resilient and vibrant rural banking sector.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: Together, let us continue to walk the path of sustained reforms.
label: negative

title: RBAP: Sustaining Reforms for an Economically Vibrant Countryside
text: Again, my congratulations and best wishes to the leadership of RBAP.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Former BSP Governor Gabriel Singson, Monetary Board Members, our partners from the banking community, our guests from the Aurora A. Quezon Elementary School, fellow central bankers, members of the media, special guests, good afternoon.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: On behalf of the Monetary Board, I thank all of you for joining us today as we celebrate the 16th anniversary of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: With the signing of our agreements this afternoon, we are on track to institutionalize our economic and financial education program for Filipino children.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: This program is important to us.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: We at the Bangko Sentral believe that persons literate in basic economic and financial concepts stand to benefit more from opportunities that development brings.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: And we believe that our elementary education system is the best place to start.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: With our Memorandum of Agreement with the Department of Education, lessons on saving and money management have been incorporated into the curriculum of 12 million public elementary students where 90% of our elementary pupils study, beginning schoolyear 2008-2009.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Last week, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas signed a Memorandum of Agreement with the Coordinating Council of Public Educators Association also for the inclusion of economic and financial concepts in private elementary school curriculum.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Today, the launching of this savings promotion program "Banking on Your Future" brings the banking sector fully on board our financial education program for millions of Filipino children.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Actually, we are looking at generating synergies from this program.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: We believe that saving as a habit can best be developed among schoolchildren who wield a strong influence in their homes and communities.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Through the children, therefore, we hope to reach out to their parents, including the unbanked.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Equally important, we believe that informed Filipinos make for better partners in ensuring that we have a sound banking system and a more efficient transmission mechanism for our monetary policy actions.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: They also wise up to financial scams.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: In the process, they help sustain balanced economic growth.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: This is the philosophy that underpins our economic and financial education program.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: We all know how resilient we Filipinos are.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Given the right tools, there is much more we can do.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: The program "Banking on your Future" is therefore an important component of our economic and financial education program.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: The support of the Banking Sector for this program is essential as you are the practitioners and therefore the ideal mentors to work with the youth regarding financial education.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: The key is knowledge sharing.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: We do look forward to banks and its branches to get involved in their neighbor elementary schools to mount parallel financial education activities and to reward best performing schools and students with prizes including savings account.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: The idea is to make it hip and cool for our students to have savings account that they can nurture and grow.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: This way, they develop the habit of saving on a regular basis.
label: negative

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Aasahan po nang ating mga kabataan ang programang ito, kasama na ang ating mga bisitang mag-aaral mula sa Aurora A. Quezon Elementary School.

title: Developing a New Generation of Savers with the Program "Banking on Your Future"
text: Ladies and gentlemen.

title: Message
text: Kami po sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas ay nagagalak dahil patuloy po ang pagtanggap at pagtangkilik sa Credit Surety Fund Program ng mga mahahalagang lalawigan sa ating bansa.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Ngayong umaga, naririto po tayo sa Negros Oriental upang ilunsad and Coopreneurs Surety Fund Program ng Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
label: negative

title: Message
text: At dahil sa itinuturing naming ito'y isang mahalagang okasyon, marami pong mga opisyal ng Bangko Sentral ang kapiling natin sa umagang ito.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Pangunahin po rito ang tatlong kasapi ng Monetary Board ng Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Naririto rin po ang aming Assistant Governor ng Supervision and Examination Sector, si Dolly Yuvienco, marami pong nagmamano sa kanyang mga Bangko; Managing Director Rory Cruz of the Currency Management Sub-Sector, siya ho ang nagbibigay sa inyo ng inyong mga currency notes and coins; Managing Director Pete Tordilla, siya po ang tatay ng mga branches and regional offices; Director Rose Dumaliang ng DLC, siya ho ang punong-abala; at si Ms. Lag Nuqui, siya po ang Head ng aming Internal Audit Office.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Our presence here today therefore indicates our deepest regard for our MSMEs, which remain as the backbone of the Philippine business community.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Considering that one-fourth of the total loans of the whole banking system was extended to this specific sector, it is clear that MSMEs are an equally important and a growing clientele of the banking sector.
label: negative

title: Message
text: In fact, we would like to look at it as a challenge to the banks because estimates indicate that sixty (60) percent of MSMEs' credit needs still remain unserved.
label: negative

title: Message
text: This is the rationale for the launching of the Credit Surety Fund.
label: negative

title: Message
text: This fund is intended to support the establishment, expansion and continued viability of MSMEs by providing them with greater access to bank loans without the traditional need for a collateral.
label: negative

title: Message
text: With the Credit Surety Fund, MSMEs can now have access to credit from banks by using the surety cover issued jointly by the parties of the Fund as collateral.
label: negative

title: Message
text: In short, the Credit Surety Fund democratizes access to bank credit and helps level the borrowing field for MSMEs.
label: negative

title: Message
text: This credit enhancement program will therefore make it less difficult for banks to comply with the requirements of the Magna Carta for MSMEs.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The key is the "assurance feature" that allows lending banks to be paid promptly in case any MSME fails to honor its commitment to the bank.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Inasmuch as the Credit Surety Fund is only one of several programs that promote better access to credit, the BSP will continue to advocate and make room for additional innovations that will benefit our young entrepreneurs, especially here in Negros Oriental.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Sa pakikipag-tulungan po ng mga LGUs dito sa Negros Oriental, ng ating mga kooperatiba, ng mga bangko at ng IGLF na nagtataguyod ng Credit Surety Fund, ang programang ito ay pagpapatunay na ang ispiritu ng bayanihan ay nananatiling buhay sa ating kultura.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Tatlong bagay po ang nais kong linawin sa umagang ito.
label: negative

title: Message
text: People are saying, "why do we need a credit surety fund when the microfinance program is in place?".
label: negative

title: Message
text: Well, you can only borrow up to P150,000.00 under the microfinance program.
label: negative

title: Message
text: With this program, we leverage on the ability to put up equity and multiply such an equity ten (10) times.
label: negative

title: Message
text: We're talking here about empowerment.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The second point is "why not the coops lending directly to their members?"
label: negative

title: Message
text: That's possible; but, again, we are trying to leverage on the partnership between the local government, the banks and the coops themselves, directly supervised by the Bangko Sentral within a well-established regulatory and supervisory framework.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Thirdly, "what is it for the provincial government?
label: negative

title: Message
text: Why should the provincial government participate in this program?"
label: negative

title: Message
text: Well, the provincial government is supposed to promote an environment conducive to entrepreneurship.
label: negative

title: Message
text: And that is what precisely this program is all about.
label: negative

title: Message
text: It empowers the cooperative movement and the coops themselves through a trust fund.
label: negative

title: Message
text: And with growth, the provincial government, as well as the national government, stand to collect more taxes to help sustain economic activity in the region.
label: negative

title: Message
text: It is my pleasure therefore to be here at the City of Gentle People, which is also the site of prestigious institutions of learning, foremost of which is Silliman University which is graciously hosting us this morning.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Given its young populace, comprising not only of students and tourists, but also of innovative entrepreneurs, it is no surprise that Dumaguete City has remained a rich source of manpower and base for several BPO centers and new small businesses.
label: negative

title: Message
text: To recall the recent history of this program, the initial launch of the Credit Surety Fund in Cavite in August 2008 was followed by the launch of the Aurora Province Coopreneurs Surety Fund in January of this year.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The third to be launched was the Bohol Coopreneurs Surety Fund in February.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Today, it is the turn of Dumaguete to join the list of fast developing cities and provinces that are helping provide the financial support to ensure the growth of small entrepreneurs.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The launch of the Credit Surety Fund here is but a testament to the successful public-private sector partnership and collaboration of the National Government, the local government of Negros Oriental, the various cooperatives here, the Development Bank of the Philippines, the Land Bank of the Philippines and the rest of the local banking community, the IGLF, and of course the BSP.
label: negative

title: Message
text: We believe that this program will succeed as long as we can keep aflame the continued synergy among all the participants to this multi-sectoral endeavor.
label: negative

title: Message
text: This Fund that we are establishing today will help us achieve our shared goal of improving the lives of Filipinos, in particular, the young and entrepreneurial residents in this beautiful province.
label: negative

title: Message
text: No doubt, the road ahead is long and difficult.
label: negative

title: Message
text: We have just taken the first of a million steps while we are at the same time facing the challenges of the current global financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Message
text: This should spur us more to work harder to create more economic opportunities that will help our people improve their financial condition, and make Negros Oriental and our country a better place for all.
label: negative

title: Message
text: In the future when the people of this province should come up with additional innovations, please let us know.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Let's sit down and progress this process to a higher level.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Together, we hope to achieve a more broad-based economic growth and development: one that is inclusive, participatory, and more meaningful to everyone.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Mabuhay po ang mga taga Negros Oriental!
label: negative

title: Message
text: Mabuhay po ang mga taga Dumaguete!
label: negative

title: Message
text: Mabuhay po tayong lahat!

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Ladies and gentlemen of the Rural Bankers Association of the Philippines led by Mr. Tomas Gomez IV, outgoing President, and Mr. Omar Andaya, incoming President of RBAP, supporters and advocates of our rural banking sector, colleagues from the Bangko Sentral, special guests, members of media, ladies and gentlemen, good morning.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: We at the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas join you in celebrating 56 years of rural banking in the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: This is 56 years of partnership with local communities in invigorating countryside development - a fruitful partnership that has seen our rural communities grow and develop alongside rural banks.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Indeed, key indicators for the rural banking sector show steady growth even in the midst of the global financial crisis and the closure of a number of rural banks engaged in unsafe and unsound banking practices.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Among others, the operating network of rural banks continues to increase.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: As of end December 2008, the network of rural and cooperative rural banks, consisting of head offices and branches, was at 2,148, higher than 2,133 in 2007.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: While there was a net decline in the number of head offices from 727 to 703 as a result of closures and mergers, this was more than offset by the increase in the number of branches.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: The net effect is a larger network capable of delivering banking services directly to a wider market.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: In addition, rural banks are exhibiting greater innovation and dynamism by seizing opportunities presented by technology.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: The industry enhanced its banking services delivery with the installation of more Automated Teller Machines (ATMs): from only 83 in 2007 to 113 as of end December 2008.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: A number of rural banks have also ventured into electronic banking to beef up delivery of financial services: the number of rural banks offering e-banking services such as cash cards and mobile banking have increased to 47 in 2008, from only 5 banks in 2005.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: It is important to note that the increasingly broader and deeper reach of rural banks, comes at a time when bank deposits in all but one of the regions were on the rise.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Consolidated deposits of 6 million savers with rural banks as of end December 2008 reached more than P 107 Billion, allowing the rural banking sector to provide more loans for agriculture as well as micro, small and medium enterprises.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Our figures indicate that nearly half of the rural banks' total loan portfolio of P106.6 billion in December 2008 went to agri-gra loans.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: I am also pleased to note that loans granted by rural banks in 2008 went up in 13 of our 17 regions.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: The business of rural banking has likewise been profitable with net income after tax at more than P 3 Billion in 2008, slightly higher than the 2007 level.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: A clear indicator of the rural banking sector's strength is its strong capital position: its capital adequacy ratio at 13.8% as of September 2008 remains well above the BSP's mandatory standard of 10%.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Of course, your CAR remains a bit lower than that for our thrift banks and universal/commercial banks.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Still, 13.8% CAR of rural banks compares well with the overall CAR of the banking sector in Malaysia with at 12.6% and Korea with 11.2%.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: And so, ladies and gentlemen, let us celebrate the continued growth and development of the Philippine rural banking sector with a long round of applause!
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Nevertheless, these positive indicators must not lull us into a false sense of complacency.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: The rural banking industry achieved these by maintaining business discipline.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: And clearly, rural banks stand to perform even better if all members of RBAP will work on having even stronger capital positions, become more vigilant in managing liquidity and credit risks, and faithfully adhere to the good governance tenets of fairness, accountability and transparency.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: I am happy to know therefore that we are on the same page, so to speak, as your convention theme this year is "Banking on Governance."
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: As declared by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), good corporate governance is key not only to the integrity of corporations, financial institutions and markets... it is also central to the health and stability of our economies.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Further, an OECD study released this year entitled "Corporate Governance Lessons from the Financial Crisis" concluded that to an important extent, the current financial crisis can be attributed to failures and weaknesses in corporate governance arrangements.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: The choice of governance as the central theme for your convention is therefore timely as it is compelling.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: I take this as a message of the deep commitment of rural banks to good governance principles, strong capital buildup, and better liquidity and risk management.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Surely, if you walk your talk, rural banks will continue on a growth track.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Indeed, we can learn a lot from the current global financial turmoil and economic downturn.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: While it has become evident that no economy is immune from its effects, we are also seeing that economies that had the political will to pursue much-needed reforms and built up buffers... are more likely to fare better than others.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Among others, the Philippines is in a relatively better position today in terms of growth prospects compared to many other economies, including advanced economies.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Our resiliency springs from the continuous implementation of reforms calibrated to strengthen our banks, our financial system and our economy.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Thus, while other countries have sunk in recession, our domestic economy still expanded at a respectable 4.6% growth rate in 2008.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: The outlook for this year remains positive, although at a markedly slower pace.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: In fact, some analysts believe the Philippines will be one of only three or four countries in Asia that will grow this year.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: A key factor that could sustain the country's growth is the strength of domestic demand.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Personal consumption, which accounts for more than two-thirds of the Philippine economy, has been historically firm, with private spending resilient across business cycles.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: As you know, the Bangko Sentral's monetary policy, as measured by recent benchmark policy rates, is supportive of sustained growth.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Easing inflation also provides a welcome boost to households' purchasing power.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Inflation as of April this year was at 4.8%, down from 6.4% in March.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Our forecast for average inflation this year is projected at 3.4%, which is well within our inflation target range of 2.5 - 4.5%.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: In addition, our remittance figures are holding up.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Remittances coursed through banks reached a record high US$1.47 billion in March 2009, representing a 3.1% year-on-year growth.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: This brought the cumulative remittances in the first quarter to US$4.1 billion, or an annual growth of 2.7 percent.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Remittances are expected to be resilient as workers with permanent resident status continue to rise; this suggests a welcome shift from yearly contract renewals to more long-term employment.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Based on actual data for January-February, the deployment of both skilled and professional workers has remained on the uptrend, generating with it higher consolidated earnings for overseas Filipinos.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: And while there have been reported layoffs, the numbers are quite small compared to the total number of overseas Filipinos.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: We also expect further growth for the business process outsourcing sector in 2009... as recession in the global economy is seen to encourage outsourcing to streamline costs.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: This scenario should challenge our rural banks to work better on growing your business and clientele so that you can capture a bigger share of our expanding economy, particularly in the resilient countryside.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: How, then, should rural banks move forward?
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: In our view, it is critical for rural banks not to waver in their resolve to pursue reforms that would ensure strength and stability of your banks.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: In this context, your banks' risk infrastructure is a key component that will allow you to identify and act on risks that may arise; credit risks and liquidity risks are particularly important.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: In the case of risks, a proactive approach is preferable over remedial management.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: For instance, credit risk can be mitigated by generating high quality information and acting prudently based on this information.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: On the other hand, it is important in managing liquidity risk to strike the appropriate balance between actively deploying funds through loans and investments and in retaining enough of a defensive position so that liquidity is available when the need arises.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Again, this poses its own challenges for rural banks because of the narrower exposures from focused lending to a local community.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Another important aspect is your commitment to maintain strong capital positions... not simply for compliance but for prudent control of leverage.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: Management should ensure that your banks have sufficient buffer whenever risks turn into losses, through careful allocation of scarce capital to alternative exposures.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: While we will not dictate your allocation, your adherence to maintain capital adequacy above our regulatory floor rate of 10% reflects commitment toward prudential control and financial governance.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: On our part, we at the Bangko Sentral will continue with banking reforms that will encourage improvement of capital positions and broaden the avenues for better risk management.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: We will move forward with the implementation of consolidated and risk-based supervision; the enhancement of corporate governance and disclosure standards; and fostering transparency in financial reporting.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: If you recall, these initiatives which we have vigorously implemented in recent years are instrumental in instilling order and depth in the banking system ahead of the onset of the global financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: The Bangko Sentral will also maintain its policy approach of enabling banks, particularly rural banks, to increase the scale and scope of their operations.
label: negative

title: Banking on Governance for Growth and Stability
text: This is a win-win strategy: first, it will enhance your banks' bottom lines and, second, it will support Bangko Sentral's inclusive banking policy to reach out to the unbanked and those who remain unserved by the financial sector.

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Mr. Francis Ganzon, Chairman, Rural Bankers Research and Development Foundation; the officers and members of the Rural Bankers Association of the Philippines (RBAP); our partners from the USAID led by Christian Hougen and John Owens; fellow advocates in the microfinance sector; special guests, ladies and gentlemen, good afternoon.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We at the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas are happy that the the National Roundable Conference of RBAP - Microenterprise Access to Banking Services (MABS) has chosen for its theme "Microfinance: The Bright Spot in These Challenging Times".
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Indeed, we believe that microfinance is an effective countercyclical tool for softening the negative effects of economic crises, particularly to the most vulnerable segment of the economy.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Former United Nations Secretary General Kofi Anan once said that microfinance recognizes that poor people are remarkable reservoirs of energy and knowledge; that while the lack of access to financial services may be a sign of poverty, it is also an untapped opportunity to create markets, bring people in from the margins and give them the tools with which to help themselves.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Especially during challenging times, it is microfinance that can provide much-needed support for our entrepreneurial poor.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: But before I discuss microfinance, I will give a brief overview of our present operating environment.. and why we live in challenging times.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The current global economic crisis is a source of worry.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Even countries that do not have strong financial links to the US, Europe or the other markets that have been most affected are now seeing effects through real flows and financial losses on trade activities.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: As the global economy slows down, jobs are jeopardized and unemployment figures in the directly affected countries tend to rise.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: In fact, there are Filipino workers here and overseas that have been laid off.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We have learned that no economy is immune from the effects of the present global crisis, described as the most serious since the Great Depression.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: However, economies with sound economic fundamentals are likely to fare better than others.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Given the structural and market reforms we had painstakingly put in place since the Asian Financial Crisis, it can be said that the present crisis came at a time when the Philippine economy is in a position of relative strength.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Indeed, our sound macroeconomic fundamentals have served us well.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: In the face of this crisis, the Philippine economy remains resilient, relative to our peers in the region.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Let me quickly run thru some numbers to show the "buffers" we have built.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our domestic economy has remained steady.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: In 2008, GDP grew by 4.6%, still within our long-term trend growth rate, and quite respectable when compared against our neighbors.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The outlook for this year remains positive, although at a slower pace of growth.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Nevertheless, this is not bad at all considering that the Philippines is one of the few Asian countries seen to grow and ride out this severe global economic recession.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our inflation rate continues to decelerate.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Headline inflation in April was reported at 4.8 pct from 6.4% the previous month.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Core inflation has similarly slowed down (to 5pct from 5.6 pct).
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The forecast average inflation for 2009 is at 3.4 pct, well within our set target range of at 2.5 - 4.5%.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our Balance of Payments is expected to continue to be in positive territory through the year.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We continue to see a current account surplus from sustained remittances and receipts from the BPO sector.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Because of our healthy external position, we have been able to build up our gross international reserves to a record-high level of $39.5 billion in April, enough to pay for more than 6 months' worth of imports of goods and services.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The positive external surplus will continue to support the peso.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: With our policy for a market-determined exchange rate, the peso is expected to remain competitive as this moves in tandem with the other currencies in the region.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our banking system remains sound.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Thanks to the innate conservatism of our banks and the phased-in approach by the regulator to financial innovation, Philippine banks' exposure to toxic assets has been minimal.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Also due to reforms implemented in earlier years to clean up bank balance sheets, strengthen bank capitalization through Basel II, improve governance structures, enhance risk management systems, and adhere to international accounting standards, the banking system remains sound and stable.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our asset base continues to expand, asset quality has greatly improved with NPL ratio now at pre-1997 crisis level, and capital adequacy has remained above national and international standards.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: And we did not see a freezing of credit markets similar to what was happening in the US and Europe then.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Given all these indicators, one could say "so far, so good"....
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Nevertheless, we are aware that risks remain....
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Thus, in October 2008, at the height of the uncertainty surrounding this crisis, the BSP implemented preemptive measures to boost domestic liquidity.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The following are among these measures: Enhancement of the BSP's standing peso repo facility by expanding allowable collateral and relaxing valuation on these; Creation of a US dollar repo facility to augment dollar liquidity in the foreign exchange market and ensure the ready availability of credit for imports and other legitimate funding requirements; Increase in the budget for our peso rediscounting facility to P60 billion; and Reduction in the regular reserve requirements on bank deposits and deposit substitutes by two percentage points.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: In addition, the BSP took the opportunity to reduce policy rates in the light of easing inflation expectations.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: During the last four policy meetings, the Monetary Board cut BSP's policy rates by a total of 150 basis points.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Combined, the lower cost of money and increased liquidity should support continued economic growth.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We will continue to monitor developments to ensure that our policy settings remain appropriate and balanced.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Nevertheless, while there has been monetary easing, the BSP remains unrelenting in its pursuit of reforms.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We will continue to pursue greater efficiency, better risk management, stronger capitalization, improved disclosure and transparency practices, and enhanced corporate governance standards in the banking system.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: So far, the reforms we have implemented have allowed our banks to efficiently perform their central role of channeling funds to productive uses, as well as in managing and distributing risks.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Having a more efficient and liquid Philippine banking sector has helped mitigate the risk of what is called the negative feedback loop from the global financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Having said these, there is a critical question that we have to face: Will the global financial crisis affect the world's microfinance sector?
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Microfinance scholars have grappled with the first question.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Unfortunately, the results from their initial studies remain inconclusive.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: One study by the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), published in March 2009 and entitled "Will the Bottom of the Pyramid Hit Bottom?"
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: 1 states that (and I quote) the crisis may ultimately lead to a squeeze in MFIs' profitability.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Due to the credit crunch, MFIs, especially those with limited deposit taking facilities, will have reduced access to commercial wholesale funds to finance their loan portfolios.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Scarce private credit and higher borrowing costs would likewise stunt their portfolios.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: MFIs would also be competing for fewer and more expensive funds for their operations and expansion.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The relative increase in prices and an overall slowdown in economic activities will also affect the profitability of clients' businesses, thus constraining their household incomes.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: As a result, leading MFI clients may fall back on loan obligations or withdraw their savings.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: On the other hand, a paper entitled "The global financial crisis and its impact on microfinance" 2 written for the Consultative Group to Assist the Poor (CGAP) last February 2009, claims that the effects of the crisis on microfinance are actually well-managed.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Authors of the paper claim that while there may be some anecdotal evidence, there have been no major negative changes in the profitability or risk profiles of MFIs.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Their study was based on the 2008 4th Quarter figures of Symbiotics 50 Benchmark which tracks large microfinance institutions worldwide.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The authors however recognize that microfinance as it is today, given greater links to domestic and international financial markets, may still be affected by the financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: However, they iterate that past investments in building a sound foundation for the sector and the vast untapped market of credit worthy clients will ensure that microfinance remains resilient amidst this current crisis.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Given these, the next question is whether the global crisis will impact Philippine microfinance.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Will it have adverse effects or darken the prospects and opportunities of Philippine MFIs?
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We at the Bangko Sentral believe that as our macroeconomy has proven resilient to crisis, we can expect the same resiliency in our microfinance industry.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: In fact, bright spots abound in Philippine microfinance.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: For instance, since microfinance in the country has been increasingly led by banks, the risks to the liability side of microfinance institutions remain more manageable.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Banks, as deposit taking institutions, are less reliant on external sources of funds and therefore less vulnerable to any reversals in foreign capital flows and shifts in investor preferences as a result of the crisis.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: While the diversification and commercialization of sources of funding has been seen as a positive industry development, retail deposits remain significant as a stable core funding base.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Further, our microfinance institutions, especially banks with microfinance operations, have demonstrated the necessary commitment to institutional strengthening.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: More and more, we are seeing banks upgrading their risk management systems to be able to adequately and appropriately identify possible risks, such as credit and liquidity risk; and how they will be managed.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Commitment to maintaining the quality of your microfinance loan portfolios has also been evident.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: I am happy to note that a culture of zero tolerance for delinquency and vigilance in monitoring of portfolio at risk is clearly evident among MABs banks.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: These are practices you must sustain, in good times and in bad.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: On the part of the Bangko Sentral, we will continue with our policy approach of enabling banks, particularly rural banks, to increase the scale and scope of their microfinance operations.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our regulations for microfinance have created the enabling environment for its practice to fully flourish within the banking sector.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We have also liberalized the branching regime, and we will continue to review this as conditions warrant.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our branching regulations also provide particular incentives for microfinance-oriented banks such as the ability to branch out even in the restricted areas of Metro Manila as well as the ability to collect savings from microfinance clients through other banking offices.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The BSP has also been receptive to various product and technological innovations in banking services.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We have also allowed the outsourcing of some banking functions to help improve your operating efficiency.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Rural banks now have more opportunities to provide a wider range of services and products to their clients such as electronic money, FCDUs, and investments in ATM networks.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Moving forward, I propose that we make these bright spots brighter.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: In this, we have our own roles to play.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: On the part of the BSP, we shall remain unrelenting in our commitment to strengthen the banking institutions through improvements in capital positions and enhanced capacities to manage risks.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Our commitment to broaden financial inclusion is undiminished; in fact, it has been heightened by the financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Given its importance, we will be more proactive in exploring ways to increase access to financial services, particularly for those who remain unbanked and unserved by the financial system.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: I believe that all of you, as our partners, share these goals.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: I therefore take this opportunity to thank the 91 rural banks participating in MABS, including their nearly 500 banking offices, for being at the forefront of delivering microfinance services to millions of Filipino microentrepreneurs.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Ladies and gentlemen, let us give our MABS-participating rural banks a well-deserved round of applause!
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Indeed, you are the crucial channels for countryside development and the catalysts for promoting a truly inclusive financial system.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: You can therefore count on Bangko Sentral's continuing support in this important task.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: While banks have accomplished much, you cannot be complacent nor rest on your laurels: Clearly, more needs to be done!
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: You must continuously monitor the quality of your loan portfolios and vigilantly maintain low portfolio at risk (PAR).
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Of course, this must be balanced with your commitment to continuously serve your microfinance clients.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: I am certain you have realized that microfinance clients who repay their loans faithfully are motivated in part by their desire to promptly access follow-on loans.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: This ensured access to finance is very important for our microentrepreneurs.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Another important commitment is for banks to maintain strong capital positions.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Capital adequacy is central to ensuring that banks have sufficient buffer whenever risks turn into losses.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Remember that our banking sector's strong capital position is one of the main reasons why it has remained resilient amidst the continuing global financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: I do look forward to banks becoming more proactive, rather than reactive, in terms of strengthening their capital positions.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Finally, I wish that microfinance institutions will look at this crisis as an opportune time to push for reforms to further strengthen the microfinance industry.... to find ways to improve efficiencies, to strengthen governance structures... to enhance the quality of its management... to diversify funding, to become more transparent... and to strengthen consumer protection.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Microfinance institutions may also continue to expand and tap new markets,...of course with appropriate caution and preparation.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: For instance, some microfinance institutions see market growth potential from returning overseas Filipinos who begin to engage in various entrepreneurial activities.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: From current indications, the global economic crisis has not negatively impacted Philippine microfinance.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: However, it is imperative that we all remain vigilant in these challenging times.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: We have seen how microfinance has improved the lives of millions of our entrepreneurial poor.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The yearly Microentrepreneur of the Year Awards program, where MABS banks always have a winner, is a regular reminder to us that access to financial services... coupled with hard work, ingenuity and perseverance... are powerful empowering tools for breaking out of poverty and building a better life not only for the microentrepreneurs themselves, but for their families and communities as well.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: You and I know of many Filipino success stories rooted in microfinance.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: The success of our microentrepreneurs continues to inspire and bring hope that it can be replicated throughout our country and liberate more Filipinos from poverty.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: This is the reason why we are all here today.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: This is the reason why we commit to work together to broaden and deepen the reach of microfinance.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: I hope therefore that this RBAP-MABS roundtable conference will be fruitful and successful in transforming our microfinance sector to be stronger, better, and even more responsive to the needs of our microentrepreneurs.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Again, my congratulations to all those involved in our microfinance sector....a truly bright spot in these challenging times.
label: negative

title: Microfinance: The Bright Spot in these Challenging Times
text: Mabuhay ang microfinance!
label: negative

text: Mabuhay ang Pilipinas!

text: Salamat sa inyong lahat!

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Introduction President Richard Barclay, distinguished members of the Australian-New Zealand Chamber of Commerce, ladies and gentlemen... good evening.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: First, let me thank ANZCHAM for inviting me to your monthly members' meeting.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: If I remember correctly, the last time I graced a similar event of ANZCHAM was in July 2005 - as I was just beginning my term as central bank governor.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Much has transpired during the nearly four years since then.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: As this particular slide shows, our economies have experienced ups and downs - riding on record growth rates, and now recessionary trends, historic low inflation, and then some episodes of highly unstable prices, stock market gyrations, as well as periods of volatility in our exchange rates.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Our journey in the last four years has taken us through good roads, so to speak.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: But we also went through road blocks and speed bumps along the way.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Now, the global financial and economic turmoil presents our economies with, perhaps, our biggest challenge yet.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: The current crisis has been described as a "crisis unlike any we have seen in our lifetime".
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: We have seen much of the crisis' adverse effect on our economies, but we know that much is still to unfold.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: For my remarks tonight, I thought I would follow the outline flashed on the screen right now.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: I will begin by quickly running through three themes that I have seen surrounding the current crisis: First, that "the law of unintended consequences" has been at work in this crisis.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Second, that a global crisis needs global responses.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Finally, that no economy is immune from the effects of this crisis, but those which have built up buffers are more likely to fare better than others.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: I shall then conclude my remarks with a description of the policy actions and initiatives that the BSP has so far implemented to allow us a less bumpy ride to the not-so-distant period of economic recovery.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Unintended consequences evident in the crisis I am sure many of you have heard of the term "law of unintended consequences".
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Some have defined this as "the proposition that every undertaking, however well-intentioned, is generally accompanied by unforeseen repercussions that can overshadow the principal intention."
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Let me illustrate, continuing with my road analogy.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: In road development, one option to deal with a traffic-congested road is to build a bypass or an alternate road.
label: negative

title: Philippines: Navigating Through The Global Financial Turmoil
text: Unfortunately, building a bypass may decongest the existing road, but as often happens, with new developments in the area of the bypass, we would now have, instead of just one congested road, two traffic congestions.
