label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Bert, Dolly, Candon and Tom were right.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Let me explain, the facts of the case.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: First, the owners of Urban Bank themselves voluntarily closed the bank by declaring a bank holiday in April 2000.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Inaccuracies and blatant falsehoods have been used to blame other people for this.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Actually, the reason is really quite simple: Urban Bank ran out of cash.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Now, you may ask, what happened to the money of the depositors of Urban Bank?
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Records show that the management of Urban Bank used P4.6 billion of depositors' money to buy doubtful receivables of its investment affiliate UrbanCorp Investment, Inc. or UII.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: The proceeds were used to service massive withdrawals and pretermination of placements of UII clients, among whom are relatives of bank officials.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: In other words, the purchase was made to favor UII investors, at the expense of Urban Bank's depositors.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Mr. Borlongan, former president of Urban Bank, has publicly declared that he considered both the Urban Bank and the investment house affiliate to be the same integral unit; that there is no distinction between the two companies.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: This is a most irresponsible view.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: The bank and the investment house were two separate corporations with different stockholders: the interest of one is not the same as the interest of the other.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Accordingly, charges of estafa have been filed in court by the Department of Justice against 11 respondents, including Mr. Borlongan.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: The cases are pending in Regional Trials Courts in Makati city.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Clearly, the Monetary Board did the right thing...by acting promptly and decisively in placing the bank under receivership.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: By doing so, we prevented the dissipation of its assets, protected the integrity of bank records, and safeguarded the interest of the depositors, creditors and the general public.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Placing Urban Bank under PDIC receivership, paved the way for its purchase by Export and Industry bank and its subsequent rehabilitation.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Unfortunately, the Court of Appeals ruled that the memorandum recommending the placing of Urban Bank under receivership a day after it declared a bank holiday, "was done in an arbitrary manner violative of fair play and committed with grave abuse of discretion."
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: This, we believe, is an unfair decision, which we will now appeal.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Our examiners had been monitoring the financial condition of Urban Bank months before it declared a bank holiday.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Therefore, we knew the following: 1.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: That its non-performing loan ratios had been consistently exceeding the industry average; 2.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: That for three months up to April 25, Urban Bank had been depending heavily on inter-bank borrowings, exceeding P5 billion a month, to meet its mounting liquidity requirements; and 3.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Urban bank was capital deficient as it could not meet the P2.4 billion capitalization of a commercial bank.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: In other words, the bank was capital deficient, illiquid, and unable to pay its liabilities as they became due.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: These findings were confirmed in Urban Bank's letter dated April 25 advising the BSP of its declaration of a bank holiday.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Please note additionally that before the closure: 1.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Urban downgraded from universal bank to a commercial bank, and with a further request to downgrade once more to a "holding company."
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Urban had made appeals for assistance from the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: BSP was trying to arrange a take-over by a stronger bank.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: BSP offered to give an emergency loan which was declined as it would not sound nice in public.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: PDIC offered to provide a loan which Urban declined for lack of collateral.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Very clearly, the closure of Urban Bank cannot be described as abrupt and done in haste.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: As such, we are confident of our stand: professionally, legally and morally.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: We believe therefore that, in time, our courts will rule in our favor.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: I explained all of these today, because it is important that you know...and believe...that we did the right thing in the case of Urban Bank.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: I want you to be able to declare -with conviction- to your friends and family, that BSPers are professionals; that they can rely on the integrity of our actions and intentions.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Outside the courts, as you have seen and heard, there is a groundswell of public support for BSP in this case.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: It is the same public that consistently votes for BSP as the top-performing government agency.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: They have kept the faith.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: I appeal to all of you therefore not to let our people down.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: In doing our work, let us continue to be guided by the values of integrity, excellence and patriotism.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: These are the very same values we have enshrined in our vision statement.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: The legal setback we encountered is temporary.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: You can be sure, we will exhaust all legal remedies available to us.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: We shall not be intimidated.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: We shall persevere.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: We shall prevail.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Once again, on behalf of Bert, Dolly, Candon and Tom - our Urban heroes, we thank you for your heartwarming and spontaneous support.
label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity

label: negative

title: Keeping Faith in the Face of Adversity
text: Muli, marami pong salamat sa inyong lahat.

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Mr. Daniel Vidal R. Arcenas, incoming president of the Rural Bankers Association of the Philippines (RBAP), Mr. Jerry B. Coloma, Jr., outgoing RBAP President, RBAP Board of Directors, members of the Association, ladies and gentlemen, good evening.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: I am pleased to join my fellow colleagues in the banking sector.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: We are bound by a common objective, that is, to promote a healthier financial system.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: As such, we are all concerned about the state of our financial institutions.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Let us look at how the rural banking industry is doing at present.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Assessment of the rural banking industry I would like to commend the rural banking industry for staying resilient in spite of difficult domestic and global conditions.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: As of March 2003, the rural banking system demonstrated overall soundness: expansion in assets, steady growth of deposits, increasing capitalization, and reasonable profitability.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: The industry's total resources stood at P82.2 billion or 11.6 percent higher than last year's P73.7 billion.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Deposits grew by 14.2 percent to P56.3 billion from P49.3 billion a year ago.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Capital accounts increased by 8.9 percent to P13.3 billion from last year's level of P12.2 billion.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: In terms of profitability, average return on assets was at 1.4 percent while return on equity was at 8.7 percent.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: It is also worth mentioning the improvement in overall asset quality.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: The industry's NPL ratio declined to 14.0 percent from 15.1 percent a year ago.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Still, I would like to encourage the industry to work doubly hard in containing the stock of non-performing assets (NPAs) which remain a severe problem, so that you can undertake new lending and resume your primary role in fund intermediation.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: The enactment of the Special Purpose Vehicle Act (SPV Act) last January is a major BSP initiative relating to the resolution of the NPA problem.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: This would pave the way for the creation of privately owned asset management companies (AMCs).
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: The Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the Act took effect on 9 April 2003.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: This sets in motion the sale of NPAs with fiscal incentives to special purpose vehicles and, in the case of residential loans and foreclosed residential assets, to individuals.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: In connection with the implementation of the SPV Act, we have issued a Memorandum to all banks/NBQBs containing procedural guidelines for the sale of such NPAs to fast track the regulatory approval process while maintaining full transparency.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: The BSP is working closely with other regulatory agencies, such as SEC and BIR, in implementing the Act.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: I strongly urge you to consider using the new law to reduce your NPAs.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: We have sweetened the package by allowing deferred recognition of losses on eligible transactions.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Moving on, let us now consider the challenges that rural banks face today.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Challenges and key reforms The difficult domestic and global economic environment pose serious challenges to rural banks.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Now, more than ever, there is need to institute reforms that would ensure the sustained viability and competitiveness of the industry.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: To hurdle these challenges, rural banks need to embrace reforms that would improve overall efficiency, strengthen risk management, build up capital base, and enhance corporate governance standards.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: We are here to support you all the way.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Our efforts to strengthen the banking reform agenda is basically geared towards helping promote greater safety, efficiency and competitiveness in the banking industry.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: One of the key reforms in our agenda is the promotion of better governance in our financial institutions.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: The broad corporate governance reform agenda is a fundamental challenge that we, as a nation, face.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Let us do our part by ensuring that there is fairness, accountability and transparency in the way we conduct our business.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Furthermore, we also need to promote leadership integrity in the entire industry, beginning with the board of directors in whose shoulders rest the responsibility of ensuring the presence of sound work ethics and effective risk management systems within the institution.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Thisis the fundamental reason why we have taken the initiative to empower bank directors through training.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: We want directors to understand the nature and scope of their responsibilities which involve setting policies and strategies, identifying key risk areas, and monitoring corporate performance as a means to achieve growth, profitability and financial stability.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Our records indicate that as of May 2003 around 60 percent of rural bank directors (from 635 rural banks) have participated in our mandatory orientation program.

text: [1] What happened to the other 40 percent?
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: What happened to the 139 rural banks who have not sent a single director for training?
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Remember, we even extended the deadline up to 30 June 2003 so that we can come up with a perfect attendance and more importantly, avoid the situation where we would be forced to disqualify directors.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Now we must act.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Our ongoing agenda on corporate governance constitutes the following initiatives: Supporting more training on specific aspects of corporate governance, particularly in improving banks' audit functions, risk management systems, and governance systems.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: We hope RBAP can continue to play a role in providing such training.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Encouraging professional certification of bank directors to raise the standards and maintain the professional and ethical practice of bank directors; and Supporting objective monitoring of progress in corporate governance practice.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Finally, I would like to highlight BSP's commitment to promote sustainable microfinance as a response to the needs of the many enterprising poor in our society.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: I am glad that our rural banks have been particularly supportive of this endeavor.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: The number of banks involved in microfinance lending has steadily risen since we first implemented the project in 2000.
label: negative

text: We now have 119 banks engaged in microlending with total microfinance loans amounting to P2.2 billion spread out to 394,613 borrowers.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry

label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Without the necessary adherence to sound practices, it can create bigger problems.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Microfinance should not be an excuse for unsound banking practices.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Conclusion At this point, I would like to call on the association to remain steadfast in promoting a healthier rural banking industry.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Your efforts will certainly help spur growth and development in the countryside, leading to more efficient and responsive services.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Ultimately, this will aid in promoting a stronger and more vibrant economy.
label: negative

title: Towards a Resilient Rural Banking Industry
text: Thank you and good evening!
label: negative

text: One of the important elements considered by economic managers is how the public views the outlook for the economy.
label: negative

title: Message
text: This is particularly true for the monetary policy of the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Public expectations are an important channel through which monetary policy affects the economy, and having information on expectations about the economy is extremely valuable to the formulation of monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Initiatives like the BES, therefore, help monetary authorities get timely information on how the business sector is responding to the current macroeconomic environment.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The BES indicates to us the economic outlook of business and industry.
label: negative

title: Message
text: It is extremely useful because it contains their short-term economic prospects and their own adaptive business strategies.

title: Message

label: negative

title: Message
text: The need for timely information about economic expectations and business activity cannot be overemphasized.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Policymakers in the Philippines and the rest of the global economy continue to struggle to engineer a sustained recovery in the face of generalized economic weaknesses.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The future path of economic policy can only be established on the basis of strong and reliable data on the progress of economic activity.

label: negative

title: Message

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Mr. Renato A. Ampil, president of the Rotary Club of Manila, other officers and members of the Rotary, friends, ladies and gentlemen, good afternoon.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: I welcome this opportunity to dialogue with you about our economy from our vantage point at the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: As community business leaders in your own right and as concerned citizens, we are all stakeholders in what is happening around us.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Let me begin with our assessment of the current economic environment, and then the key challenges ahead, and BSP's policy initiatives.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The economy in brief What's the big picture?
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Despite the generally weak global environment, the country continued to post favorable economic performance.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: For the first quarter of 2003, GNP growth stayed robust, benign inflation reigned, low interest rates and a relatively stable peso exchange rate prevailed.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Real GNP and GDP grew by 5.6 percent and 4.5 percent, respectively, propped up across the board by the strong performance of the services, industrial, and agriculture sectors.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Economic growth has been fostered in a low-inflation environment.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The slower increases in the prices of both food and energy-related items caused average inflation rate for the first four months of 2003 to settle at just 2.9 percent.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Consequently, average inflation for 2003 is expected to be well below the original government target of 4.5-5.5 percent.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: During the first four months of 2003, the 91-day Treasury bill rate averaged 6.1 percent, slightly higher than a year ago but still quite low by historical standards.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The slight uptrend in T-bill rates mainly reflected market uncertainty over the impending war in Iraq.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: However, with that issue now resolved, the T-bill rate has settled at 5.5 percent as of the latest auction.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The balance of payments (BOP) as of the first two months this year remained in surplus of US$55 million As a result, the country's gross international reserves reached $16.1 billion as of end-May 2003.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This is sufficient to cover 4.5 months imports of goods and services.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The country preserved its favorable foreign exchange liquidity position due to sustained export growth and steady flow of workers remittances.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The banking system at a glance As far as the Philippine banking system is concerned, it continued to manifest overall stability in the face of many uncertainties in domestic and global conditions.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Key financial indicators of the Philippine banking system in 2002 reflected overall soundness: steady growth of deposits, resumption of lending, increasing capitalization, and improving profitability.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Total resources aggregated P3.5 trillion as of end-December 2002, up by 6.6 percent from a year ago.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The banking system also recorded 7.0 percent increase in deposits, 2.5 percent loan growth, 4.6 percent increase in capitalization, and near doubling in net income after taxes (NIAT).
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: However, the large holdings of non-performing assets (NPAs) remains a major issue.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: At end-year 2002 total NPAs stood at P504.2 billion, equivalent to a little over 14 percent of total banking system assets.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Two-thirds comprised non-performing loans and the balance represented acquired assets or ROPOA.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This overhang of NPAs continues to put pressure on affected banks and poses a major obstacle to full resumption of lending activity.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: It is imperative to reduce the stock of NPAs to more manageable levels.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: After more than a year of painstaking work with Congress, the Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) Act was finally enacted last January.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This would pave the way for the creation of privately owned Asset Management Companies (AMCs).
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: It is our major initiative to resolve the NPA problem.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The implementing rules and regulations (IRR) of the Act became effective on 9 April 2003.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This sets in motion the sale of NPAs with fiscal incentives to special purpose vehicles and, in the case of residential loans and foreclosed assets, to individuals.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Through this approach, we expect to mobilize fresh private investments, especially foreign investments, to resolve the NPA problem.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We have also issued a Memorandum to all banks/NBQBs containing procedural guidelines for the sale of such NPAs to fast track the regulatory approval process while maintaining full transparency.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The BSP is working closely with other regulatory agencies, such as SEC and BIR, in implementing the Act.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Last week, the Monetary Board decided to allow banks to also defer recognition of losses arising from such NPA transfers subject to full disclosure and dividend restriction.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This is intended to provide further incentive to banks to get rid of their NPAs soonest.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Towards sustaining reforms Despite a generally improving outlook for the economy, there is a pressing need to address a number of challenges.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: At the forefront is the critical task of containing the budget deficit primarily through better revenue collection.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The success in achieving fiscal stability will greatly assure sustained economic growth with low inflation and peso stability.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We all need to fully support the government in its drive to improve revenue collection and rationalize fiscal expenditures without compromising the need to address social and development objectives.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: As a monetary authority, we will also stay firmly committed to our basic mandate of sustaining low inflation.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Since last year, we have adopted an explicit inflation targetting framework to ensure that BSP stays focused and accountable on inflation performance.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Moving on to the banking system, our basic agenda is to ensure basic safety and soundness of the system as a whole and to promote greater efficiency of the financial system.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Key reforms involve: (1) the strengthening of the regulatory and supervisory framework in line with international standards, (2) promotion of better corporate governance in banks, and (3) development of critical financial market infrastructure and systems.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We are actively promoting corporate governance reforms in the financial system through empowerment of the board of directors collectively and as individuals.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We started by more clearly defining their duties and responsibilities.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We followed through by requiring all bank directors to go through a mandatory orientation course or else face disqualification as directors.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We would like to build on the momentum already achieved by: Supporting more training on specific aspects of corporate governance, particularly with regard to the proper functioning of banks' audit committees, risk management committees, and governance systems, in compliance with global standards.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Encouraging professional certification of bank directors to raise the standards and maintain the professional and ethical practice of bank directors.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Supporting objective monitoring of progress in corporate governance practice.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: In the area of financial market development, the BSP has sustained the initiative to improve our basic infrastructure.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: In November last year, we launched the Philippine Payment System or PhilPaSS.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This is a real time gross settlement system compatible with international standards designed to minimize settlement risk for high value payments between banks and reduce possible contagion should a crisis occur.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We are also strongly supportive of a BAP project to develop a fixed income exchange which will allow the efficient secondary market trading of government securities and other securities that may be issued by banks and other private issuers.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The development of a local bond market is a critical goal that will promote a healthier and more efficient financial system.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We are presently too dependent on the banking system for financing developmental needs leading the unnecessary fragility as banks try to meet long-term financial requirements with essentially short-term funding sources.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: We are likewise signing a Memorandum of Agreement with the Philippine Clearing House Corporation to establish a world-class cash management center, a facility that will provide an efficient and cost-effective system of handling and processing currency notes for circulation.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: These reforms all form an integral part of the BSP's broader banking reform agenda that is geared towards further strengthening the financial sector, reducing our overall vulnerability and promoting a high level of efficiency.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: But we also recognize that the basic building block of a strong financial system is the quality of human resources behind it.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: As a modest contribution, we will be launching today on the occasion of our 10th anniversary " Money and Banking in the Philippines - Perspectives from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas."
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This is intended to be a textbook for college-level students.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Finally, let me end by highlighting our efforts to develop a banking system that is also responsive to the needs of the many enterprising poor in our society by actively promoting the concept of sustainable microfinance.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: This is not a doleout program but a means of providing access to savings and credit to the poor so that they can help themselves and live a life of dignity that they deserve.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: The number of banks involved in microfinance lending has steadily risen since 2000.
label: negative

title: Recent Economic Developments, Prospects and BSP Initiatives
text: Presently, a total of 119 banks are engaged in microlending As of May 2003, microfinance loans amounted to P2.2 billion spread out to 394,613 borrowers.

title: Message
text: Amidst the many uncertainties brought about by the Asian financial crisis, the economic slowdown in the U.S. and an impending global recession, the Philippine banking system has continued to be at the center of the flow of funds that connects savings, investments and expenditures which are requisites to national progress.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Given this, the Bangko Sentral has intensified its program of institutional and structural reforms within the supervisory framework defined by the General Banking Law of 2000 and the Central Bank Act of 1993.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The BSP initiatives have been aimed at further promoting the development of a sound, effective and modern banking system, at the same time upgrading our compliance with international banking standards.
label: negative

title: Message
text: These include the adoption of risk-based capital adequacy norms, measures to address dollar speculation and exchange rate volatility, consolidated supervision of financial conglomerates and the issuance of guidelines for banks offering e-banking services.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The BSP has also issued rules and regulations designed to combat money laundering.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Anti-money Laundering, Micro-finance, the Special Purpose Asset Vehicle Bills have become the latest advocacies of the BSP in pursuit of our mission of providing pro-active leadership in bringing about a strong financial system that is supportive of the requirements of economic growth.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Parallel to the efforts of maintaining the soundness of the banking system, the Bangko Sentral has been the guardian of price stability.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Ø The average inflation of 6.1 percent last year was at the lower end of the 6.0-7.0 percent target range.
label: negative

title: Message
text: For the six months of 2002, average inflation was 3.6 percent, lower than the government's target of 4.5-5.5 percent for the whole year.
label: negative

title: Message
text: Ø Interest rates are at the record low levels.
label: negative

title: Message
text: As of June, BSP's policy rates stood at 7.0 percent for the overnight borrowing rate and 9.25 percent for the overnight lending rate, the lowest in ten years.
label: negative

label: negative

title: Message
text: Ø"> The peso, which faced depreciation pressures in 2001, has strengthened since the beginning of 2002.
label: negative

title: Message
text: The gross international reserves have continued to climb.
label: negative

title: Message
text: As of end June 2002, the GIR stood at almost U.S. $17 billion, which can adequately cover 5.6 months worth of imports of goods and services.
label: negative

title: Message

label: negative

title: Message
text: The BSP has been very transparent by regularly conveying to the public our monetary policy actions and reasons for these actions.
label: negative

text: With the completion of the Lucena branch building, we hope to substantially upgrade the quality of our services to this community: Ø First, we expect to be able to efficiently service the currency requirements of some 200 branches of commercial, thrift and rural banks in the cities of Lucena, San Pablo and Batangas and in the provinces of Quezon, Laguna, Batangas and Marinduque by making available crisp currency notes and new coins.

label: negative

label: negative

label: negative

title: Speech
text: As most of you are aware of by now, the Philippines has an economic plan focused on fiscal discipline, good governance, market-oriented reform, and poverty-reduction.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: As the Governor of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, I would like to reiterate my continued support for this plan and its implementation.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: I also reiterate my confidence that the Philippine economic team is in place to ensure that the objectives included in the plan will continue to be achieved and more importantly, create an enabling environment that everyone in the business community particularly, the exporters will benefit from.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Among the initiatives that we, at the Bangko Sentral, have been taking to support the Government's economic plan include three important areas: first, is price stability; second, is introducing banking sector reforms; and third, is introducing institutional reforms to pave the way for good governance practices.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: All these are aimed toward creating a level playing field for all the key players in Philippine business.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Price stability To my mind, one of the most crucial steps being taken by the Arroyo administration is the emphasis on instilling fiscal discipline throughout the public sector.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The ability to meet revenue and expenditure targets, and thus reduce the budget deficit are significant steps toward stabilizing the cost of funds.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: While the Government is focused on instilling fiscal discipline, my team at the Bangko Sentral is working to ensure that price stability becomes the norm rather than the exception.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: As you all know, the Bangko Sentral has shifted monetary policy to inflation-targeting since January of this year.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: This practice, which is employed by many other countries, has price stability as a primary focus.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: With this policy, the Bangko Sentral and the National Government are both committed to reach an explicit nominal inflation target directly, without compromising the broad economic targets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The Bangko Sentral is also highly focused on maintaining calm in the currency markets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Our goal in this regard is to achieve overall price stability, root out speculative activity and to continue to support the Government in meeting its fiscal targets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The maintenance of a market-determined exchange rate policy has to be supported by a strict and effective foreign exchange monitoring system and a strong commitment to apply penalties to institutions or individuals who violate foreign exchange regulations.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: You know as well as I do that a relatively stable exchange rate is important for keeping inflation under control and is good for business planning.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: So far this year, the peso has been trading at a much lower 100-day volatility of only 4.4% as of mid-April this year, from 19.6% during the same period last year.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The Bangko Sentral is also ensuring that the financial system is sufficiently liquid.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The issue of addressing rising NPL's ranks high in our list of priorities and is being dealt with a mix of short and long-term measures.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Among the short-term measures are the monitoring of capital adequacy ratios on account of their cushioning effect, and the aggressive reduction in policy rates to encourage banks to reduce their lending rates accordingly.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Long-term measures being taken to reduce NPL's include supporting the passage of the bill creating special purpose asset vehicles.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The lower House version of this bill has been approved on 3rd reading and now awaits the senate version before the Bi-cameral Committee meets to ratify a unified version, hopefully before Congress goes into recess in June.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Other institutional measures we have taken are the preservation of an appropriate interest- rate differential to encourage investors to maintain their peso denominated assets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: And finally, our efforts to support price stability include work we are carrying out to develop secondary markets for fixed income and derivative products.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Instituting banking reforms The Bangko Sentral is also committed to increasing foreign participation in the Philippine banking sector.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: We are introducing reforms that are preparing domestic banks to effectively compete in a globally integrated banking environment.
label: negative

title: Speech

label: negative

title: Speech
text: Second, we are enhancing the Bangko Sentral's supervisory and regulatory powers in line with international standards by introducing risk-based capital requirements, tighter loan classification and provisioning rules, and consolidated reporting.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: We will also be imposing stiffer penalties for any violations of Philippine banking regulations.
label: negative

title: Speech

title: Remarks
text: I am happy and honored to be able to participate in these ceremonies to launch Citibank's search for the Microenterpreneur of the Year.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Truth to tell, I originally had another important appointment this morning but, as luck would have it (for Citibank), the appointment was put off for another day and so I am free to come here today.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I am happy to be here for two reasons.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It always feels good to be back in the company of former colleagues in Citibank, especially the Chairman and CEO, my good friend Victor Menezes, who I remember trained in Citibank Manila before embarking on an eminently successful banking career.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The second reason is I strongly believe in microfinance as the major factor that will get our countrymen out of the clutches of poverty.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: At the outset, I would like to congratulate Citibank, therefore, for this initiative and I refer particularly to my good friend Cathy Weir, the Country Corporate Officer, who now has the added distinction of presiding over the celebration of Citibank's centennial in the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: To properly appreciate the significance of microfinance and this award that we are launching this morning, consider these statistics.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: In a population of 74 million Filipinos, 37% live below the poverty line.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This poverty incidence translates to 5.2 million number of poor households or approximately 29 million people.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: That is the extent of the poverty problem in the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It is true that some 4 million poor families are engaged in some form of entrepreneurial activity.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: However, only 961,000 families can avail of credit because of the exploitative interest rates charged by so-called five-six operators and the inability of borrowers to produce collateral that is normally required by banks.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: If this search for Microenterpreneur of the Year succeeds in making the poor realize that there is a credit mechanism called microfinance, which dispenses small loans without collateral, and at affordable interest rates, it will have made a meaningful contribution to poverty alleviation in our country.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We bankers sometimes overstate the importance of economic statistics like GNP growth and increase in per capita income.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Quite obviously, these growth indicators do not filter down to the masses of our people and this gives rise to the refrain that the rich become richer and the poor remain poor.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The plight of the poor must be addressed with specific solutions and the one solution that we in the Bangko Sentral can see that will make a difference is microfinance.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Microfinance, which means loans of as little as P2,000.00 and no more than P150,000.00, is the means by which the entrepreneurial poor can improve their quality of life and join the mainstream of society.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: No less than President Arroyo identified microfinance in her State of the Nation Address last year as the cornerstone of her fight against poverty.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Given the fact that there are only 400,000 microfinance borrowers today, her goal is to raise this figure to 1 million by 2004, or something like 300,000 new borrowers a year.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is a specific goal that is at once a challenge to all of us.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Microfinance services are currently being provided by the formal and informal sectors.
label: negative

text: Tied to the People's Credit and Finance Corporation, the quasi-government Apex Microfinance Institution, are 180 active conduits composed of 62 cooperatives, 28 NGO's, 24 cooperative banks, 64 rural banks, and 3 thrift banks all over the country.

title: Remarks
text: While it seems that we have this large number of microfinance providers, there is still much to be done.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It is estimated that the current providers are reaching only 10% of the intended market.

title: Remarks
text: At the Bangko Sentral, we are doing our part in encouraging the spread of the microfinance gospel, so to speak, and encouraging the poor to avail of their services.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We have been aggressive in creating enabling policy and the regulatory environment for the establishment of sustainable microfinance institutions.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We are conducting training and information dissemination on microfinance technologies and best practices to the end that these institutions remain viable and effective service providers.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I am pleased to see that we are not alone in this effort.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This project of Citibank of recognizing successful microenterpreneurs will provide additional impetus to the effort.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Properly motivated and managed, microenterprises can serve as the driving force to invigorate local economies.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The success of these businesses, no matter how small, has a multiplier effect on the lives of the individual entrepreneurs, their families and their community.

title: Remarks
text: And they showcase not just their businesses but also their discipline in meeting their obligations, and their social responsibility.

title: Remarks
text: And yet this is not all that this project is bound to achieve.

title: Remarks
text: It will showcase as well the very microfinance institutions that provided the services for the successful enterprises.
label: negative

title: Remarks

title: Remarks

title: Remarks
text: I would like to begin by greeting all of you on this annual membership meeting of the Bankers Association of the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I would like to take this opportunity to discuss a major issue which is both current and relevant, not to say urgent, in our efforts to overcome obstacles in the way of faster economic growth.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is the implementation of the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2001, now referred to as AMLA.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We signed the Implementing Rules and Regulations (or IRR) last March 13.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The signatories were the representatives of the BSP, the Securities and Exchange Commission, and the Insurance Commission, who constitute the Anti-Money Laundering Council, and the members of the Bicameral Congressional Oversight Committee who are mandated by the law to approve the IRR.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Let me discuss the salient features of the IRR.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The Law, if you remember, was greeted with doubts and criticism when it was passed last year, on the heels of threats of countermeasures from the Financial Action Task Force.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Among other things, critics said it did not have enough teeth and may not meet the standards of the FATF.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Much was said about the requirement for a court order, to enable the Council to inquire into bank deposits, as well as the very short list of covered crimes.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The FATF itself observed that the threshold amount of P4 million was too high for the Law to be able to cover all attempts, to use the proceeds of unlawful activity.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I am happy to inform you that the IRR, apart from being merely a guide in the implementation of the Law, has addressed these issues to our satisfaction.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It explains in detail, for a better understanding of the magnitude and intent of the Law, what the provisions mean and how to carry them out.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: On the issue of predicate offenses, the Law mentions only 14 covered crimes which, in the view of some people, were too few considering the numerous ways and means by which criminal elements can unload dirty money.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The IRR has broken down the 14 covered crimes under the Law, and came up with 114 specific offenses.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The enumeration is not exclusive.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Some violations of the E-Commerce Act and the Securities Regulation Code may not have been listed in the IRR, but the Council is clear that all such violations are predicate offenses.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: In fact, similar offenses punishable under the penal laws of other countries, are also predicate offenses in our jurisdiction.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Regarding the question of the threshold amount, while the IRR upholds the mandatory filing of covered transaction reports, in excess of P4 million, the IRR requires supervising authorities to report all, and I repeat all, suspicious transactions, regardless of the amount involved, to the Council.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: A transaction is suspicious when, in the words of the IRR, "There is reasonable belief that a money laundering activity... is about to be, is being, or has been committed."
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The rule is money laundering is money laundering, regardless of the amount involved.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: In other words, the P4 million threshold amount is for mandatory reporting only.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: In fact, the Bangko Sentral has issued a reminder to the traveling public, to declare in writing, foreign currency in excess of US$10,000 that they are bringing in or out of the country, together with information as to the source and the reason for transporting the money.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is part of our effort to close all possible loopholes that may be exploited to move dirty money.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Another contentious issue, which we hope the IRR has put to rest, is the anxiety over the need for a court order, to inquire into bank accounts of suspected money launderers.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is perceived to be one red tape, that may give a chance to the perpetrators to withdraw their money before the Council can put its hands on it.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The fact is that under the rules - and the Law itself - the Council can freeze an account without a court order, and when it does, the account is effectively immobilized for 15 days.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The bank is prohibited from touching the frozen account, without prior clearance from the Council.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Under the Law, no court can issue a temporary restraining order, or writ of injunction, against the freeze order, except the Court of Appeals and the Supreme Court.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The intervention of the court comes only when, first, there is a need to extend the 15-day limitation of the freeze order and, second, when the Council needs an authority to examine the deposit prior to or during the institution of criminal proceedings, involving the offense for which the deposit is related.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Again, the freeze order is valid regardless of the amount of money found in the deposit account.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: All that the Council needs to be able to issue a freeze order, is a determination of a probable cause, that the account is in any way, related to any unlawful activity or a money laundering offense.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The IRR is very particular about customer identification and record keeping on the part of the banks and other covered institutions.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The IRR goes to the extent of requiring that "No new account shall be opened and created without face to face contact."
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Numbered accounts are allowed but the banks must keep the true identity of the account holders.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Records must be kept for five years from the dates of the transactions.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Another issue addressed by the IRR is the effectivity of the Anti-Money Laundering Law.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is important because some critics contend that with the constitutional prohibition on the retroactive application of criminal statutes, deposit accounts opened before October 17, 2001, which is the date when the Law came into effect, can become the "sanctuary" for laundered money.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The IRR says this will not happen.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It says the Law will apply to all transactions on or after October 17, 2001, even if they relate to or involve deposit and investment accounts opened before that date.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The Council and the Bicameral Congressional Oversight Committee spent many days and long hours discussing and reviewing the Implementing Rules, and we are confident that we have crafted a document and a process that works.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We have since submitted the IRR to the FATF and we hope that its meeting in Australia in June this year will begin the process of removing the Philippines from the list of countries described as non-cooperative in the global campaign against money laundering.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: While the FATF considered our Anti-Money Laundering Law signed last year as insufficient, it acknowledged that we had made significant progress and effectively withheld the imposition of countermeasures that could have wreaked havoc on the economy.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The determination of our compliance with the FATF standards of cooperation will take sometime, because they will need to find out first, if our Law and the Implementing Rules work.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This brings me to make this new appeal for the cooperation of all covered institutions, especially the banks.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We all know now our role in the Law and in the Implementing Rules and Regulations.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It is in our interest as a nation participating in a global campaign to make this effort work.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Let me close these remarks with a word of gratitude and confident in the thought that the Bangko Sentral can count always on the understanding and cooperation of the Bankers Association of the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I have, as you all know, a close affinity with the BAP and will continue to rely on this personally in the pursuit of our common goals.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: (Note: Annual Membership Meeting, Bankers Association of the Philippines, March 25, 2002, Shangri-La Hotel, Makati City)

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: I am happy to have this opportunity to keynote this seminar on anti-money laundering here at the Development Bank of the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The DBP has the unique distinction of being the bank that is probably the closest to our people in the countryside.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: I hope that through you and your extensive network of branches and offices, our people would develop a clear understanding of what money laundering is and what we are trying to achieve for their benefit by enacting a law to fight it.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The successful implementation of the law needs the full support of all sectors of society.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: Republic Act 9160, otherwise known as the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2001, was passed by Congress and signed into law on September 29, 2001, amidst anxiety over the prospect that if it was not passed the Philippines would be subjected to sanctions by the rich countries organized under the banner of the Financial Action Task Force or FATF.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The sanctions would have wrought havoc on our economy that was already suffering from the effects of a global economic slowdown triggered by the September 11 terrorist attacks in the united states.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: Much has been said about the sanctions, ranging from our foreign currency transactions, like OFW remittances, being subjected to unnecessary scrutiny, to the issuance of adverse advisories by global financial centers which could have brought the flow of foreign investments into the country to a complete halt.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: We are off the hook at the moment but not completely.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: We are going to remain in the list of non-cooperative countries until we have proven to the satisfaction of the international community that R.A. 9160 works and can in fact discourage money launderers from using the Philippines as a haven where they can convert money derived from illegal activities like kidnapping, drug trafficking and smuggling into what would look like legitimate income.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: This is why, soon after the enactment of the Law, I went to Hong Kong and Tokyo and Finance Secretary Camacho went to the United States to begin the campaign to persuade foreign audiences that we have a good, clear and enforceable law, and one that meets international standards.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: There will be continuing dialogue with foreign officials and organizations and I am confident that these would lead to the recognition and acceptance of this Law by the international community as an effective instrument in the global campaign against money laundering.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: There are five provisions of R.A. 9160 that directly address concerns that the FATF expressed when we were advised about our inclusion in the list of non-cooperative countries last year.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The first is criminalization, meaning that money laundering is now a crime in the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The second is the establishment of a system of covered transaction reporting.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The Law identifies the forms of business institutions or "covered institutions" which are required to submit reports about suspicious or "covered transactions" to authorized persons.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The third is the creation of an Anti-Money Laundering Council that will administer the implementation of the Law.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The fourth is the amendment of Bank Secrecy Laws which have been blamed for making our country a potential haven for money laundering.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The Law assures, however, that while the objective of the law is to ensure that the country is not used for money laundering, the policy continues to be to protect and preserve the integrity and confidentiality of bank accounts.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The fifth is the institution of procedures and arrangements that facilitate cooperation between the Philippines and foreign governments in the investigation, tracking and prosecution of money launderers.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: A key provision of the Law is the creation of the Anti-Money Laundering Council which has the responsibility to implement the Law.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The AMLAC, as we call it, is composed of the Governor of the Bangko Sentral as Chairman, and the Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Insurance Commissioner as members.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The composition of the AMLAC is reassuring.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: It is tantamount to a vote of confidence on the reputation of the constituent agencies for neutrality, independence, trustworthiness and good performance.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The most essential attribute of an anti-money laundering program is its integrity and I am confident that the BSP, the SEC and the Insurance Commission will be able to deliver on that.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: We have, in the meantime, completed the implementing rules and regulations and submitted them to an oversight committee composed of representatives of both houses of Congress created by the Law.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The Committee is mandated to act on the draft of the implementing rules within a few days from its promulgation after which the Anti-Money Laundering Council can begin to work in earnest.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: This can be as early as a few days from now.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: Our fervent hope is that we will have the support and cooperation of all sectors to make R.A. 9160 work to the end that we can effectively block all avenues for money laundering attempts in our country.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: Apart from the need to respond to possible international countermeasures against the Philippines in September, it is in our national interest to join the community of nations in the fight against money laundering.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: Money laundering can undermine the integrity of financial markets, can adversely affect currencies and interest rates in view of distortions that can be caused by volatile funds, and can thereby threaten monetary stability.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: Above all, money laundering poses a threat to national security as it contributes to the expansion and empowerment of criminal organizations, which can ultimately undermine political and economic stability.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: The September 11 terror attacks in America demonstrate how proceeds of money laundering can destabilize even the most powerful nation on earth.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: Even as we speak, our Congress is looking beyond the limits of the Anti-Money Laundering Law.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: We are aware that similar bills have been filed in both houses of Congress following the lead and format of R.A. 9160 in order to address the growing menace of terrorism in the country.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: We wanted to include terrorism in addition to the 14 "covered crimes" or predicate crimes in the Anti-Money Laundering Bill but we could not do so because terrorism is not yet a crime in the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Looking Beyond R.A. 9160
text: And so, in the same manner that R.A. 9160 criminalized money laundering, the effort in Congress now is to declare terrorism a crime in the statute books as well.
