title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Distinguished Board of Directors, officers and members of the Bankers Institute of the Philippines (BAIPHIL), ladies and gentlemen: good evening.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Being a part of the BAIPHIL family, I am truly honored and pleased to attend this momentous event.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: As sustaining life member, a title which was conferred to me while I was still with PCIBank, I have known of BAIPHIL's generosity and selfless efforts to uplift the banking sector's image.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: I would like to commend BAIPHIL for this and for all the other meaningful endeavors it has embarked on for the past 60 years.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Through the years, BAIPHIL has been a key force in the banking community with its wide-ranging activities that promote productivity enhancement through research, information exchange and education.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In this capacity, it has remained supportive of Bangko Sentral's call for upholding, at all times, a highly professionalized approach in the conduct of banking -- one that is anchored on excellence and safe and sound banking practices.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Indeed, this makes BAIPHIL a vital partner of the Bangko Sentral in its goal of revitalizing the industry and sustaining overall soundness and stability.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This occasion is a perfect opportunity to reaffirm that partnership as we gather to assess the current situation of the banking system and find workable solutions to the challenges that confront it.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The banking system at present The Philippine banking system today remains fundamentally sound, but there is urgent need to sustain reforms if it is to fully regain its vitality and vigor.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: We all realize that the current economic environment, burdened by a global economic slowdown, is a particularly tough environment for banking.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: However, it would be immensely counterproductive to simply hunker down, hoping to ride out the business cycle, and avoiding real reforms that improve operating efficiency, strengthen risk management, build up the capital base, and above all, improve corporate governance.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Now is the time to act decisively while we still have sufficient maneuvering room.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: As of September 2001, the banking system continued to be very liquid and well capitalized.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Deposits grew further by 9.2 percent.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The net worth-to-risk assets ratio stood at 16.4 percent (as of end-August 2001), which is way above the indicative minimum of 10 percent.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The overall asset base still managed to expand by a respectable 6.8 percent.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: However, appetite for new lending has remained rather muted; loan growth has stayed essentially flat.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: To an important extent, weak economic conditions have dampened loan demand but a rising level of non-performing assets is also clearly a factor.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Deteriorating asset quality has in turn adversely affected bank profitability.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This state of affairs cannot be sustained in the long run as, eventually, it will erode the solvency position of the banking system.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: A comprehensive response What should be done to address the problem?
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: First of all, there is need to stimulate economic recovery.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Toward this objective, the Bangko Sentral has significantly reduced policy interest rates by 675 basis points since December 2000.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This was made possible by lower inflationary pressures.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: We are looking forward to reducing interest rates further under the right conditions that will not compromise basic monetary stability essential to sustaining confidence.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: However, easing monetary policy alone cannot be expected to do all the work.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This will only create an unsustainable macroeconomic imbalance.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Other elements will also need to be put in place.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: I am glad to note that the Government is responding comprehensively to address all relevant issues including security, trade and investment, agricultural productivity, and fiscal concerns.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Second, there is need to focus on the asset quality problem.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In the last couple of years, the Bangko Sentral has been strongly encouraging banks to build up loan loss reserves in response to growing pressures on loan portfolio.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This has resulted in a buildup of loss provisions to the equivalent of 43.4 percent of non-performing loans and 27.4 percent of total non-performing assets from 34.6 percent and 26.5 percent, respectively, in June 1997.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This effort has strongly contributed to protecting financial system soundness and maintaining overall public confidence.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: However, the accumulated stock of non-performing assets, totaling P486.2 billion as of end-September 2001, needs to be trimmed substantially from bank balance sheets so that banks can operate more normally, be less distracted, and focus again on providing fresh credits to the economy.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In this regard, the Bangko Sentral fully supports the creation of Asset Management Companies (AMCs) as vehicles for reducing the non-performing assets in bank portfolios.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: However, this will have to be primarily funded by the private sector and be market-driven.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Neither the Bangko Sentral nor the government have plans to set up a publicly funded AMC to absorb the non-performing assets of banks.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This is not a realistic option from a budgetary standpoint.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In my view, the role of the Bangko Sentral should be primarily supportive and enabling in nature.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This is best achieved by formulating banking regulations that are flexible and conducive to the operation of private AMCs.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The Government can also provide further incentive to private AMCs by reducing or even eliminating transactions related taxes and fees on the transfer of non-performing assets.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Doing so is likely to encourage more voluntary transactions and more effective asset cleanup.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Recently, we have also initiated a review of our loss provisioning framework.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This primarily aims to rationalize the requirements to achieve a better matching between minimum required provisions and underlying asset quality.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: As a result, we are lowering the general loan loss provision on normal, non-problematic loans from 2 percent to 1 percent to be calculated on the latest loan balance.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: However, we are imposing a 5 percent minimum provision on restructured loans even if these are in current status.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Furthermore, we are simplifying the provisioning requirement on substandard loans to 25 percent if unsecured, and 10 percent, if secured.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: With respect to ROPOA or acquired assets, we are now requiring mandatory re-appraisal of such assets every other year to effect a closer alignment between book value and economic value.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This will lead to a more transparent presentation of financial statements.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This brings me to the third crucial ingredient.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: There is need to rapidly implement banking reforms to prevent the recurrence of future crises.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The key reforms involve the promotion of better corporate governance and greater commitment to risk management.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Towards enhanced corporate governance At this point, let me highlight the initiatives undertaken by the Bangko Sentral specifically aimed at promoting better corporate governance; encouraging greater transparency and disclosure; pursuing anti-money laundering campaign; and upholding risk management practices.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Working on the premise that a bank's good corporate governance is the primary responsibility of the Board of Directors, we have clearly defined an expanded set of duties and responsibilities of the bank Board of Directors in line with international best practice (Circular No.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: 283 dated 17 May 2001).
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Said duties and responsibilities accentuate the need to select highly qualified and competent directors who can collectively act as a board to guide corporate strategy, shape policy, and oversee management.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Meanwhile, the implementing circular (Circular No.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: 296 dated 17 September 2001) on the fit and proper rule based on Section 16 of the General Banking Law of 2000 prescribes more demanding qualification requirements for directors and officers, and expands the grounds for their disqualification.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: An innovative feature of this Circular is a mandatory Director Education Program.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In line with improving the quality of bank disclosures, we require banks to disclose relevant and timely information in their quarterly published statements, audited financial statements, and annual reports.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Meanwhile, relevant information on the Philippine banking system, including published statements on individual banks, are now made available to the public through the BSP website.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: For the record, we are reviewing our disclosure rules to further boost transparency in line with latest international practices.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The fight against money laundering Last 29 September 2001 the Anti-Money Laundering Act or Republic Act (RA) 9160 was enacted.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The Anti-money Laundering Council has now been established to spearhead implementation.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In the months prior to this development, the BSP has been actively crusading against money laundering activities.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: >We rapidly set up a regulatory framework to thwart money laundering activities that may be conducted through banks and other financial institutions.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In line with this, we issued pertinent regulations establishing criteria for customer identification, record-keeping, and reporting of suspicious transactions.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Likewise, we have required banks to develop anti-money laundering programs.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Building on these early initiatives, I am confident we will be able to immediately implement fully the Anti-Money Laundering Law.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Strengthening risk management In line with the focus on risk management, we have formally shifted to a risk-based capital adequacy framework with the issuance of BSP Circular No.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The new framework took effect on July 1, 2001.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Given this new framework, banks are now required to have a minimum regulatory capital equivalent to at least 10 percent of their total assets weighted according to relative credit risk.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: The next step is to incorporate market risk, particularly exposures to currency risk, interest rate risk and equity risk, into this framework.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Draft guidelines are now being exposed to the industry for comment.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: We are also working closely with the industry to develop the standards and benchmarks to help guide banks' compliance with international risk management practices.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In cooperation with the BAP, a market risk reference manual has been developed.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This will be the basis for banks to develop their own operating procedures and for the BSP to update regulations in this area.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: A similar project to strengthen credit risk management is under consideration.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: In terms of our supervisory approach, we are emphasizing a risk-based approach that focuses on the ability of banks to detect, evaluate, and respond appropriately to their risk exposures.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: We want to make sure that banking institutions understand and control the types and levels of risks they assume.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: We are also upgrading our off-site surveillance systems to improve our ability to detect problems early and allow more proactive intervention.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: We are looking forward to the early enactment of amendments to the BSP charter to institutionalize supervisory reforms and to strengthen problem bank resolution arrangements.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Concluding remarks This broad range of initiatives will go a long way towards reinvigorating the banking system and ensuring its long-term efficiency and viability.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: To support reforms in the banking system, I strongly believe in the parallel development of the domestic capital market.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: This is long overdue.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: A more developed capital market will reduce funding demands on the banking system and facilitate better diversification of risks.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: I would also like to highlight our strong support for microfinance.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Through microfinance, our banks can make a more direct contribution to the fight against poverty and reach out to our countrymen who have long had minimal access to the banking system.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: At the same time, this is not necessarily inconsistent with sound and prudent banking principles since microfinance, when it is properly executed, is really dependent on sound credit principles for its success.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: There is so much to be done.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: True, the challenges are formidable.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: But the opportunities are more exciting.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: BAIPHIL, with its decades of experience, especially in training and professional education, has a very important role to play in keeping all of us abreast with all the developments taking place.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: More than ever, the demand for high-quality training will continue to rise.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: I am confident BAIPHIL will be more than ready and willing to respond to the challenge.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: I wish you success in all your future endeavors.
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: Thank you and happy anniversary!
label: negative

title: Working Towards a Revitalized Banking Industry
text: (Note: 60th Anniversary Celebration, Bankers Institute of the Philippines, Inc. (BAIPHIL), December 4, 2001, Manila Polo Club)

title: Remarks
text: Introduction I would like to begin by thanking the Subdivision and Housing Developers Association (SHDA) for inviting me to speak today at its business meeting My remarks today will focus on the enduring dynamic partnership of government and the private sector, and the ways in which policymakers, and the BSP in particular, are helping provide an enabling economic environment to spur economic activity.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The government-private sector partnership Building the path to sustained non-inflationary growth remains a shared challenge for both the government and the business sector.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Amidst the challenges of the global economic environment, the crucial role of the private sector has become even greater in providing the sustaining momentum for economic growth.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The housing and real estate sector, in particular, plays a major role in economic pump-priming efforts because of its impact on ancillary industries such as construction and the building materials sector.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: More importantly the housing sector serves not only as a valuable instrument to spur economic growth but also as a vital component of the National Government's social policy towards the eradication of poverty.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We therefore look to the efforts of private developers, such as the members of SHDA, both in providing the catalyst for more vigorous economic activity and in producing affordable housing for the masses.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The role of government At the same time, the government is also doing its own part in fostering the development of the housing and real estate sector.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: For the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), this involves providing a supportive economic environment through sound and coherent macroeconomic policies.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It also means implementing policy measures that would assist in the development of the real estate industry, particularly the housing sector.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I would like to discuss these briefly.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Our efforts to ensure a supportive macroeconomic environment have centered on our principal mandate of preserving price stability, while also supporting the economy's output growth objective.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Ensuring a reasonably low level of inflation helps reduce the uncertainty in economic decision-making, so that individuals and businesses have a reliable basis for long-range decisions and plans.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Thus, the monetary policy stance of the Bangko Sentral has remained focused on this objective.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Subdued inflation, spare capacity, and broad currency stability have enabled us to pursue an accommodative monetary policy-one that is supportive of an interest rate environment consistent with the BSP's price stability objective for most of 2001.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: In the past 10 months or so, the BSP has reduced its policy interest rates by a total of 425 basis points.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This reduction has contributed to the general decline in domestic interest rates over the same period.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The average 91-day T-bill rate, for example, averaged at 9.9 percent during the last auction on 22 October 2001, a significant drop from about 15.8 percent in November 2000.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Similarly, bank lending rates have also declined noticeably to a range of 13.2-14.8 percent in the last week of October 2001 from a high of 18.9-20.8 percent in November 2000.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Fostering a supportive macro environment also involves ensuring a sound banking system, one that can serve as a reliable channel for the transmission of monetary policy and an effective intermediary of funds between both savers and investors.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: To this end, the BSP has continuously implemented various reforms in the banking sector.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is borne out of the belief that better financial intermediation will give freer rein to vigorous business activity.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We are also aware that stronger business confidence is part of the key to increased domestic demand, and the best way for the Government to boost private sector confidence is to reaffirm its proven commitment to policy reforms.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Measures implemented in the banking sector during the period 2000-2001 have been aimed at achieving the following: Setting the framework for financial reforms through the passage of the General Banking Law of 2000.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Among others, the GBL 2000 provides the legal basis for the shift to risk-based capital, for improving corporate governance standards in banks, for implementing consolidated supervision, for further promoting competition in the banking system.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Implementing risk-based capital adequacy framework with the promulgation of Circular 280 effective July 1, 2001.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Strengthening disclosure standards and aligning them with international norms to enhance the bank's transparency and accountability.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Improving risk management practices of banks through such initiatives as joint development with the industry of a market risk reference manual.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: As a template for best practice exchange rate and interest rate risk management a similar project is planned to improve credit risk management.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: These initiatives are being reinforced by BSP's accelerated shift to risk-based supervision.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Promoting and improving corporate governance in banks.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Circular 283 was issued outlining the duties and responsibilities of directors.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Additionally, Circular 296 prescribes more stringent qualification standards for bank directors and senior officers.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It also emphasizes director education.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Creating a stronger and more competitive banking system through mergers and consolidations and further liberalization of foreign bank entry.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Passing into law the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2001.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Improving economic activity The various policy initiatives of the BSP have continued to pay off in terms of a stable economic picture.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: During the first ten months of 2001, inflation was within the Philippine government's target of 6-7 percent for the entire year.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is a result partly of the continued prudence of monetary policy and stable food prices.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Latest readings on inflation also bolster our confidence that the inflation target of 6.0-7.0 percent for 2001 will be achieved.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Equally important, the country posted one of the strongest economic growth rates in the Asian region in 2001, with a GDP growth rate of 3.3 percent in the first half.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This was due to the better-than-expected GDP growth performance in the second quarter, driven largely by consumer spending.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: For the year, there are also indications that the agriculture sector will achieve about 3 percent growth and that the services sector will maintain its steady growth performance.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I believe that these factors point to the underlying strength of the Philippine economy, and should contribute to an encouraging growth performance in 2001.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: At the same time, the housing sector continues to show its resilience in these difficult times, registering a 1.9 percent growth in Goss Value Added (GVA) partly as a result of government's efforts in implementing shelter programs for the poor.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: In the months ahead, the combination of subdued inflation and improving credit conditions should provide a boost not only to the overall economy but also real estate and construction activity.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: These conditions will allow domestic demand to take over the reins of growth while external demand remains weak due to the global economic slowdown.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Meanwhile, the banking system continues to be sound and generally stable amid the challenging environment.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is reflected in the 11.3 percent year-on-year growth in its total resources as of July 2001.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Asset quality remained manageable despite a recent uptrend in non-performing loans.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: As of July 2001, the NPL ratio of commercial banks reached 17.72 percent.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The capital buffer of the banking system likewise remained adequate as the capital adequacy ratio reached 16.1 percent as of end-July 2001.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is well above the 10 percent minimum required by the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: BSP initiatives related to the housing sector Apart from pursuing sound economic policies, recent BSP initiatives on the housing sector involve measures intended to support socialized and low-cost housing.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: These measures included the following: BSP Circular No.

title: Remarks
text: 190 dated 16 February 1999 included bank lending to socialized and low-cost housing projects as a form of alternative compliance under the Agri-Agra law (P.D.

title: Remarks
text: BSP Circular No.

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Pulley, Mr. Hecker, Miss Buckles, Mr. Ryan, fellow anti-money laundering advocates, ladies and gentlemen: I am most happy to welcome you to this forum, which is unlike any other that I have addressed in the last few weeks.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: I come, if you will permit me, with a big sigh of relief that finally we have a Philippine Anti-Money Laundering Law, Republic Act 9160.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: I am sure that even our foreign guests know the effort that went into the passage of this law.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Considering the proximity of the September 30, 2001 deadline imposed by the Financial Action Task Force, both Houses of Congress went into marathon hearings in their few remaining session days in September, following a two-week recess, to reconcile more than a dozen bills that had been filed separately.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Finally, on Friday, September 28, their Bicameral Committee met here in this building and, together with members of our Inter-Agency Task Force, we worked until early morning of the following day, Saturday, to come up with the bill that President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo signed into law on the same day to beat the FATF deadline by one day.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: I hasten to add that while it was important to meet the September 30 deadline to avoid the sanctions threatened by the FATF, the proponents of this law worked for its enactment mainly because it was in the interest of our country to do so.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: We live in a global community and the Philippines must be perceived as cooperative in the global campaign against money laundering.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: We are only too aware of the corrosive effects of money laundering on financial systems.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: We cannot permit our financial institutions to be used to launder proceeds from criminal activities.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: We appreciate the interest of our foreign guests in seeking an update on the passage of this anti-money laundering legislation.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: What I will try to do is to give you an overview of this new law especially as it addresses the concerns of the FATF and how it works in the context of our desire to protect the integrity of our financial system.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: I am happy to note that the department of the treasury of the United States has issued a statement welcoming the passage of the new law.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The FATF in Paris is also reported in the papers to have announced the suspension of countermeasures until presumably they are able to review the law during their meeting in February next year.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: It was the U.S. Treasury Department that issued an advisory in July last year telling banks in the U.S. that, in view of the supposed lack of counter-money laundering controls in the Philippines, to give, and I quote, "enhanced scrutiny", unquote to all transactions involving persons and institutions in our country.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Accordingly, the FATF tagged us as one of 15 non-cooperative countries in the fight against money laundering.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The FATF raised principally five issues in the case of the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: One, money laundering was not a crime.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Two, banking laws were excessively secretive.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Three, there was no suspicious transactions reporting program.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Four, there was no implementing agency.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: And five, there was no formal arrangement that allowed cooperation with other countries to prevent money laundering.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: All these concerns are covered in Republic Act 9160 and it is our hope that this law and our compliance with the deadline will lead to the removal of the Philippines from the FATF blacklist.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The law declares as a statement of policy the preservation of the integrity and confidentiality of bank accounts and the determination to ensure that the Philippines shall not be used as a money-laundering site for the proceeds of any unlawful activity.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The law also commits the country to extend cooperation in transnational investigations and prosecution of persons involved in money laundering anywhere in the world.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The law covers 14 unlawful activities, or predicate crimes as the lawyers call them, and these include kidnapping for ransom, drug trafficking, graft and corruption, smuggling, hijacking and even local gambling games like jueteng and masiao.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The institutions covered where money laundering can conceivably occur include not only banks and other institutions regulated by the Bangko Sentral but also insurance companies and investment houses.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: This is why the implementing agency, the Anti-Money Laundering Council, will be composed of the Governor of the Bangko Sentral as Chairman, the Commissioner of the Insurance Commission and the Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The Council has the power to freeze accounts, to institute forfeiture proceedings, to file criminal complaints and to cooperate with other countries in going after money launderers.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The benchmark figure for suspicious transactions is P4 million or its equivalent in foreign currencies.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The way the law describes the process, action begins when a covered institution like a bank reports a covered transaction to the Anti-Money Laundering Council.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: A covered transaction can be a deposit or withdrawal that, in the view of an authorized officer in the bank, may be related to an unlawful activity.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: When the council determines that a probable cause exists, it orders the bank to freeze the account.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The depositor is given time to question the freeze order.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: If the explanation is satisfactory, the freeze order is dissolved.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Otherwise, this is a signal for the Council to file a complaint with the Department of Justice or the Ombudsman.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Money laundering cases are tried either at the Regional Trial Court or the Sandiganbayan.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Under the law, a court order is required when the Council wants to scrutinize the account or to extend the freeze period.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Critics claim that the resort to a court order can be an obstacle to the speedy response to a money laundering case.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: What the critics overlook is that even if the case is delayed as a result, the depositor cannot move his money because the account is frozen.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Note also that no court can issue a temporary restraining order in a money laundering case except the court of appeals and the Supreme Court.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The Bank Secrecy Law is effectively amended because the new law permits the courts to order the examination of an account on the say so of the Anti-Money Laundering Council.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Moreover, as previously mentioned, banks are now permitted to report suspicious deposit transactions, whether in pesos or foreign currency, without violating the bank deposit secrecy laws.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: This is a major improvement in having access to questionable deposit movements.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Having said that, the confidentiality of deposits continues to be protected under the new law.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Following our example, officers of the bank and everybody involved in reporting the questioned transaction are strictly prohibited from disclosing this information to any person.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Violators, including the media if the information is published, can be held criminally liable.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: Another provision that enhances the confidentiality of deposits is that which allows numbered accounts for both peso and dollar non-checking depositors provided that the banks keep a record of the true identity of the depositors.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: This protects peso accounts particularly because, heretofore, only dollar accounts are allowed to use numbers.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The law, meanwhile, prohibits the use of anonymous accounts or accounts under fictitious names, a prohibition that, heretofore, exists only in administrative circulars of the BSP.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The penalties for violation of the law are stiff.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: There are fines and prison terms for money launderers and even those who merely facilitate the offense.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: A person or an institution which fails to report a suspicious transaction can also be penalized.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: There is a penalty as well for malicious reporting, meaning a person who knowingly reports false information.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: This provision is there to prevent abuse or harassment.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: I have tried to highlight the salient provisions of the law to give our guests an indication of the extent of our commitment to stop money laundering from taking root in our country.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: This early there are critics who say that this law will not pass the standards of the FATF.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: One newspaper said the other day we Filipinos seem to be "gluttons for punishment."
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: To them we say, like in most anything new we have to start somewhere and we honestly feel that R.A. 9160 is a good beginning.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The Anti-Money Laundering Council is mandated to submit the implementing rules and regulations to a Congressional Oversight Committee in 30 days from the effectivity of the law.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: We will do that.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: We have now established the legal foundation for criminalizing money laundering.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: The next thing to do is to make it work.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: I will be happy to answer your questions.
label: negative

title: Republic Act 9160 in Perspective
text: (Note: Roundtable on Anti-Money Laundering Law, Accelerating Growth Investment and Liberalization with Equity (AGILE), 5 October 2001, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas)

title: Speech
text: Secretary Camacho, Secretary Perez, distinguished members of the Singaporean Financial Community, honored guests, ladies and gentlemen, good afternoon.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: As you have heard from Secretary Camacho, the Philippines has an economic plan focused on fiscal discipline, good governance, market-oriented reform, and poverty-reduction.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: As the Governor of the Central Bank, I would like to reiterate my support for this plan and its implementation and also my confidence that there is a team and a strategy in place to ensure that the objectives included in the economic plan will be achieved.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Allow me, therefore, to spell out the initiatives that we, at the Central Bank, have been taking to support the Government's economic plan.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Our efforts have been directed in three important areas: first, achieving price stability; second, introducing banking sector reforms; and third, introducing institutional reforms to pave the way for the good governance practices that will assist in making the Philippine economic plan a reality.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Price Stability To my mind, one of the most crucial steps being taken by the Arroyo Administration is the emphasis on instilling fiscal discipline throughout the public sector.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The ability to meet revenue and expenditure targets, and thus reduce the budget deficit, are significant challenges that must be accomplished.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: While also addressing rampant speculative activity in some quarters of the financial markets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: While the Government is focused on instilling fiscal discipline, my team in the Central Bank has also been concentrating on restoring calm to the currency markets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: I am pleased to say that we have seen some initial success in this very important area.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Our goal in this regard is to achieve overall price stability and to continue to support the Government in meeting its fiscal targets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: As many of you are aware, our currency, the peso, like many other currencies around the world, has been the object of some speculative pressure.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: In addressing this pressure, we have taken a two-fold approach to our currency challenges by reducing liquidity levels in the market through hikes in liquidity reserve requirements, and by being diligent and relentless in warding off speculators.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: We have done this by exposing banks and by imposing fines when they are found to have violated foreign exchange regulations.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Our efforts have resulted in a strengthening of the peso from a low of PhP 53.57 to the U.S. dollar three weeks ago to its current level of close to PhP 51.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: A relatively stable exchange rate is important for keeping inflation under control and is good for business planning.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Our next step is to ensure that price stability becomes the norm rather than the exception.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: To achieve this, the Central Bank will be implementing a number of institutional measures.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Those measures include: A shift in monetary policy to inflation-targeting by January of next year.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: This practice, which is employed by many other countries, has price stability as a primary focus.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: It achieves that stability by committing to reach an explicit nominal inflation target directly without compromising the broad economic targets of the government.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: This differs from the present practice of using a monetary aggregate targeting framework, which uses money supply as an intermediate target.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Other institutional measures that we are taking include the preservation of an appropriate interest-rate differential to encourage investors to maintain their peso denominated assets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: They also include the maintenance of a market-determined exchange rate policy.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: This policy, however, must be supported by a strict and effective foreign exchange monitoring system and a strong commitment to apply penalties to institutions or individuals who violate foreign exchange regulations.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: And finally, our efforts to support price stability include work we are carrying out to develop secondary markets for fixed income and derivative products.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Instituting Banking Reforms The Central Bank is also committed to increasing foreign participation in the Philippine banking sector.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: As such, we will soon introduce reforms to prepare domestic banks to effectively compete in a globally integrated banking environment.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: The reforms will fall within the framework of first, improving the banking sector's structure; secondly, enhancing the Central Bank's supervisory and regulatory powers in line with international standards; thirdly, heightening bank transparency and disclosure; fourthly, improving risk management; and finally, stimulating the consumer-oriented credit environment.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Our work to strengthen the banking sector through such steps as imposing capital requirements in accordance with international standards and by promoting greater competition will certainly encourage banking sector consolidation and provide opportunities for greater foreign participation in the sector.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: In enhancing our supervisory powers, the Central Bank has introduced risk-based capital requirements, tighter loan classification and provisioning rules, and consolidated reporting.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: We will also be imposing stiffer penalties for any violations of the Philippines banking regulations.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: In heightening bank transparency and disclosure, the Central Bank will monitor the banks' selection of external auditors and require strict adherence to the "Know your customer rule".
label: negative

title: Speech
text: We will also require the quarterly publication of statements of condition, key financial indicators, non-performing loans, and related-party lending.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: In improving risk management, the Central Bank will institute an early warning system for bank failures, assist banks to better match their foreign currency assets and liabilities, and carry out reviews to identify regulatory loopholes in the transactions of bank-affiliated FOREX corporations.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: In an effort to stimulate bank lending, the Central Bank will encourage the financing of micro-enterprises by providing incentives such as liquidity assistance through re-discounting.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: We will also relax certain collateralization requirements and partially lift the general moratorium on the licensing of new thrift and rural banks to allow the establishment of institutions who are committed to micro-enterprise financing.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Institutional Reforms and Good Governance These reforms, if they are to have the desired impact, must be complemented by both good governance practices and strong political will.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: For this reason, we are seeking amendments to the Central Bank Charter that will institutionalize many of these reforms and reinforce the position of the central bank as a governing and independent body for monetary policy and supervision.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: In considering amendments to the Central Bank Charter, we are looking to add criteria to close or placing banks or other financial institutions under receivership in line with international standards.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: We also want to strengthen criminal and administrative penalties for any violation of banking laws, and to introduce measures that will increase the Central Bank's operational efficiency.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Finally, I am very optimistic that we will soon see the passage of an Anti-money Laundering Bill in both the Philippine Congress and Senate.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: This is something that the Central Bank has been working on over the past several months.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: I would like to assure you that this bill is being taken very seriously and has gained popular support not just in the legislative arena, but also amongst the general public.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Let me make it perfectly clear, the Central Bank is committed to promoting and enforcing international standards of banking regulation and supervision.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Because of this, we have zero tolerance for illegal practices such as money laundering.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: These are not empty words.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: My Central Bank team and my colleagues in government will be steadfast in instituting the reforms that will strengthen our banking sector and promote good governance.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: My former associates and colleagues in the Philippine banking sector can certainly attest to my determination to work with the Government to achieve its growth targets.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: And while I am holding the reins at the Central Bank, good governance policies and practices will be non-negotiable.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Before I close and take your questions, I would just like to reiterate that we recognize that restoring the Philippine economy to health is a significant challenge.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: But, I am very optimistic that this challenge will be met because we are approaching this task with a clear plan, a team of experienced professionals who are managing this process and a commitment throughout President Arroyo's administration to ensure that the Philippine's path to prosperity is based on a strong foundation of economic reform.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: Thank you very much and good day.
label: negative

title: Speech
text: (Note: Luncheon meeting with the Singaporean Financial Community, 24 August 2001, Shargri-La Hotel, Singapore)

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Mr. Edgardo E. Tumangan, officers and members of the Rotary Club of Manila, friends, ladies and gentlemen, good afternoon: I.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Introduction It is a pleasure to join you again at this membership meeting of the Rotary Club of Manila.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Occasions such as this one bring to mind the importance of a dynamic government-private sector partnership in confronting the challenges we face today.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: I believe that, now more than ever, the role of the private sector--in particular, the business sector as represented by groups such as the Rotary Club--is crucial and indispensable in the effort to sustain the economy's growth momentum.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Given this, the continuing challenge for government, and the BSP in particular, is in providing a sound macroeconomic environment to support economic activity.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The BSP is specifically tasked to provide direction in the areas of monetary policy and banking.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Allow me to discuss some of these issues with you today.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Recent Policy Initiatives The BSP's efforts to ensure a supportive environment are centered on its primary mandate of maintaining stable prices, while broadly supporting the economy's output growth objective.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We did this in the early part of the 2001 by reducing policy interest rates consistent with an accommodative stance of monetary policy.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: BSP policy rates were reduced from the beginning of the year by a total of 450 basis points to provide room for market interest rates to go down and thereby encourage economic activity to strengthen.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: This was in addition to the earlier reduction of 150 basis points in BSP policy rates in December 2000.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: In recent months, however, the movements in international oil prices and the peso-dollar rate have posed upside risks to the inflation outlook.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: These factors have prompted us to reassess our monetary policy stance and focus on addressing potential inflationary pressures.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The stability of the foreign exchange market is of particular concern because sharp and sustained movements in the peso-dollar rate have a pass-through impact on consumer prices by raising the cost of imported inputs for production.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: To address potential inflationary pressures, the BSP recently increased its liquidity reserve requirement by 2 percentage points.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: This was aimed at moderating liquidity growth and, at the same time, helping temper speculative activity in the foreign exchange market.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: There are indications that part of the foreign exchange market activities in recent months have been funded by the excess peso liquidity in the system.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Tempering liquidity growth will reduce the potential for speculation in the foreign exchange market.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: It will also bring overall monetary growth in line with the downwardly revised growth targets for 2001 based on the weaker-than-expected upturn in economic activity.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We have implemented other policy measures to further ease pressures on the peso.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The BSP expanded the Currency Risk Protection Program (CRPP) by providing a hedging mechanism to a greater number of users, specifically market players wanting to frontload their future foreign currency requirements and borrowers wanting to cover unmatured foreign currency obligations.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We tightened monitoring of foreign exchange transactions of banks and reduced the ceilings on undocumented over-the-counter foreign exchange sales.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We also did away with the 3-tier pricing mechanism for the placement of overnight funds by banks with the BSP.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Some help came from the private sector as well.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Notably, member banks of the Bankers' Association of the Philippines (BAP) agreed to voluntarily reduce their overbought foreign exchange positions so as to help improve foreign exchange supply.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: With the measures that we have implemented, the exchange rate has stabilized, closing at P53.15 yesterday.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Promoting a stronger domestic banking system remains another key priority for the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We believe that a healthy banking and financial system will be better equipped to provide for the financial intermediation needs of our domestic industries.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: To this end, the BSP implemented a host of policy changes involving the banking system.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: For example, we issued various regulations to implement the General Banking Law of 2000, the basic legal fabric governing the entire banking system.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Various circulars were issued by the BSP in 2001 on the following: Definition and classification of banks and the prerequisites for the grant of universal banking authorities; Guidelines on microfinance loans to small and medium enterprises; Guidelines for the new risk-based capital adequacy requirement, which took effect on 1 July 2001.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Meanwhile, the BSP continues to be at the forefront in pushing for the legislation against money laundering to protect the integrity of our financial institutions.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Thus, the BSP intends to push for the passage in congress of a comprehensive Anti-money Laundering Law, as a key legislative priority.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We take heart that the president in her State of the Nation Address has certified as urgent this law, which incorporates all the basic elements of an anti-money laundering system covering the proceeds of crimes including plunder, graft and corruption, illegal drugs, smuggling, kidnapping, as well as financial and tax fraud.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The reforms introduced in the General Banking Law of 2000 will be complemented by the proposed amendments to the BSP Charter.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: These amendments aim to enhance the BSP's supervisory powers, improve prudential standards, and promote greater banking competition.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Key reforms include the grant of authority to the BSP to conduct more frequent banking examinations, restoration of the BSP's tax-exempt status with respect to open market operations, and the enhancement of the scope and strength of administrative sanctions.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: These proposed changes will lead to what we call a "safer financial architecture" inasmuch as they help fortify our banking system against various potential shocks.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Key Economic Results The measures I have outlined to you have contributed over the last few months to a more favorable economic environment and a more sustainable path to long-term growth.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: For example, inflation has been kept in check in the past few months.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Actual inflation continues to be on track relative to its projected path for 2001, averaging at 6.8 percent in the first seven months.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Latest readings on the inflation environment are consistent with our expectations that the inflation target of 6.0-7.0 percent for the year will be met--although perhaps the actual value will be closer to the higher end of the range.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: At the same time, our financial system continues to be for the most part stable and sound.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Total assets continue to expand, with the capital-to-risk assets ratio at 16.95 percent as of April 2001 compared to 16.21 percent in December 2000.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Asset quality has remained relatively manageable, with the non-performing loan ratio for commercial banks settling at 16.81 percent as of May 2001.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Meanwhile, our accommodative monetary stance earlier in the year has led to a general downtrend in market interest rates.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The 91-day treasury bill rate, for example, fell from a high of 16.72 percent in November 2000, when political tensions were running high, to 9.22 percent at the latest auction on 30 July 2001.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Similarly, banks' lending rates declined to a range of 12.62-14.25 percent for the period 26 July - 1 Aug 2001 compared to 18.3-20.2 percent in the first week of December.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: As a result, domestic credit continued to expand, rising by 10.08 percent in May with higher loans extended to both the public and private sectors.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The resulting expansion in credit has provided the basis for moderate economic growth in the face of domestic concerns and weak external demand.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Real GNP grew by 3.6 percent in the first quarter of 2001, underpinned by personal consumption and government spending on the demand side, and by the agriculture and services sectors on the supply side.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The resiliency of these productive sectors will provide a steadying influence for economic growth in the face of the ongoing global economic slowdown.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Concluding Remarks Despite our progress in pushing the economy further along the path to long-term sustainable growth, much still needs to be done.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Uncertainties stemming mainly from external developments are present.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The particular concern is how to deal with the ongoing slowdown in global economic growth.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The lingering weakness of the major economies such as the U.S. and Japan have affected the exports of their trading partners.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: As a result, countries like the Philippines have to rely on themselves to provide the impetus for economic growth.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We can do this with higher consumption spending, and the key to doing this is by keeping up consumer confidence.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: This is why I spoke of the role of the private sector at the beginning of my talk.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: At the same time, the Government, for its part, recognizes that sustained economic expansion requires the implementation of a credible and consistent policy framework, as a complement to structural reforms aimed a fostering a vibrant economy.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: The key challenge is to accelerate the pace of the reforms in the infrastructure, financial, and agriculture sectors to boost domestic and external confidence and to enable a recovery in investments on a durable basis.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: We have weathered many difficult challenges in the past, and I have no doubt that we can get through the present problems posed by the weak global economy.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: What is different today is that there is a greater collective awareness of the need for genuine economic reforms and a greater commitment to address our problems accordingly.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: This is our key to creating the sustaining momentum for economic growth in the years ahead.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Let us strive to preserve this commitment.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: Thank you and good afternoon.
label: negative

title: The BSP: Ensuring the Proper Environment for Sustainable Growth
text: (Note: Fifth Membership Meeting, Rotary Club of Manila, 09 August 3000, Manila Hotel)

title: Remarks
text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I am pleased that you can join us today.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: You and your businesses are important contributors to the Philippine economy and today, I want to review important initiatives that the government is taking to ensure that there is a regulatory environment to enable you and others in the private sector to carry out your business activities with certainty and transparency.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The Anti-money Laundering Bill, which we will review in a moment, is key to the creation of a stable and predictable environment for the private sector.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Central to this stability, and our economic recovery, is a strong banking system, which requires a regulatory framework in line with international banking standards.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Toward that end, the Central Bank is continuing to encourage bank consolidation in accordance with prudent banking standards.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: And those banking standards include addressing the global issue of money laundering.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: As you know, our country has recently been placed on a list of Non-cooperative Countries and Territories, or NCCT, by the Financial Action Task Force, an agency created a decade ago by the G7 economic powers to co-ordinate international efforts to fight trading in questionable cash.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: To give you some background, the financial action task force originated from the G7 summit in Paris in 1989 and has the support of 29 countries, including the global financial centers of the U.S., the UK, Switzerland, Hong Kong and Singapore.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The task force also has the support of two other international organizations, the European Commission and the Gulf Cooperation.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Inclusion on the NCCT list is not something anyone should be proud of and it is something that is totally inconsistent with the government's effort to promote investor confidence and enhance the environment for investment.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We have been working with the international financial community including the U.S. Treasury on this issue for the past year.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: As the lead agency in developing the Anti-money Laundering Bill, let me say that I believe that this bill will support the maintenance and growth of foreign investment in the Philippines while protecting the rights of businesses and individuals to confidentiality.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Without the bill, we run the risk of increasing the exposure of most, if not all, of our foreign exchange transactions to unnecessary scrutiny.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We also run the risk that additional sanctions, together with stricter surveillance, processing and verification requirements, will be imposed - a potential disincentive for investment in, and business with, Philippine companies.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: That would be a very real consequence should the Financial Action Task Force continue to include the Philippines on the NCCT list.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: There are also two other consequences to noncompliance that will jeopardize our efforts for economic recovery and your normal conduct of business.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The first is adverse advisories.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: These, if issued about the Philippines to warn international banks and other financial institutions, will create a bias, encouraging international banks to take caution when handling any Philippine-based transaction.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This will mean that your normal business transactions may be considered or treated as possibly suspicious, in many cases discouraging foreign parties from investing or doing business with Philippine companies.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: The second consequence is an increased risk of a breach in the confidentiality of deposit accounts since a NCCT inclusion means that foreign banks can require absolute and general waivers on account ownership confidentiality before accepting transactions for processing.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This requirement also adds to the cost of business because the additional documentation and verification associated with general waivers translates into more work and therefore more time spent in processing transactions.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: It is with these business consequences in mind, along with the spirit of international cooperation and a commitment to see the Philippines benefit from full participation in the global economy, that we are promoting the Anti-money Laundering Bill.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Through the Anti-money Laundering Bill, the government is doing its part to create a stable and predictable environment in which you can continue to conduct your business.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We are making this necessary reform to increase the confidence in our banking system.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: This is consistent with our commitment to economic recovery, which we believe can only take place if it is underpinned by good governance and effective institutional reform.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I can also assure you that implementation of the Anti-money Laundering Bill will be carried out in a fair and transparent manner.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: We are a business-oriented government and we want to see you succeed and continue to contribute to the Philippine economy.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: I can also assure you that any questions that you have about the bill will be answered.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: Allow me to now turn the presentation to Atty.
label: negative

title: Remarks
text: De Zuniga who will provide you with further details and the structural framework of the bill.
label: negative

title: Remarks

label: negative

title: Remarks
text: That perspective has proved to be a valuable guideline as this bill has been developed and reviewed.

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: The idea of gathering the alumni to show how successful the people trained in Citibank have become was subsequently copied in other countries.
label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: Whether one agrees with it or not, it became a spectacular way for Citibank to show its contribution to the development of managerial talent in a country.

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: By then, it was common knowledge that the frequent source of managerial talent for banks was Citibank.

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: I am sometimes asked to explain how this phenomenon came about.

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: I think it all started when top management in New York decided that Citibank grow 15% per annum.
label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: The bank could do that only if it had a cadre of people to make it happen.
label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: So young people became apprentices for 4 or 5 years before they could become an officer of a bank.
label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: Citibank decided to put an end to that mindset.
label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
text: Citibank said that anyone who had an MBA from a good school could be taught to become a manager in one year and be given a position of responsibility immediately.
label: negative

label: negative

label: negative

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

label: negative

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze

label: negative

title: Monument More Enduring Than Bronze
