title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Introduction Mr. Adrian H. Thomas, Conference Manager and Head of the Asian Division of Euromoney, distinguished participants to this Seventh Annual Asia Pacific Issuers and Investors Forum organized by Euromoney: Let me begin by expressing my deep appreciation to the conference organizers for inviting me to keynote the Euromoney Investors Forum, which is the leading regional gathering for the capital markets in Asia.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: For more than two years now, developments in Asia have been the focus of grave investor concern.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: But I am sure that you will agree with me that the foundations for economic recovery in the region are now beginning to be laid, in almost all cases being accompanied by a painful restructuring and reform program.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Relative stability in international markets have been restored starting the second quarter of this year, and the International Monetary Fund has also projected a stronger growth in most Asian economies in the first year of the new millennium.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The fundamentals of the Asian economies can be now be said to be better than at any time since the 1997 crisis.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The regional financial crisis has highlighted the importance of nurturing investor confidence in national policies.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: In particular, the key role played by transparency in policy formulation, and the timeliness and accuracy of financial and economic information has been underscored.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This forum, therefore, is an important step in maintaining this confidence.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Please do not interpret my statements as indicating that we have become sanguine about our growth prospects.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: In the Philippines, we are only too acutely aware that sustained recovery and sustainable growth requires continued hard work.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This is reflected in our commitment to our economic reform agenda.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: In the spirit of transparency, therefore, let me now provide you with greater detail about how we have coped with the crisis.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: My focus will necessarily be on the Philippines, but you will find me drawing on issues of current regional concern.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The Role of the BSP At this point, let me underscore certain distinguishing features of the Philippine monetary system, which served it in good stead in weathering the Asian financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: As the Philippine central monetary authority, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) is mandated by the Philippine Constitution to provide policy directions in the areas of money, banking and credit; to supervise the banking system, and to regulate other financial institutions such as finance companies.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The BSP's primary mission is to deliver price stability conducive to a balanced growth of the economy.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The BSP enjoys policy independence in the pursuit of this mission.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This is guaranteed not just by ordinary law but by the Philippine constitution itself.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The onset of the financial crisis in Asia has provided a major challenge to the bank's adherence to this mission, and at times has subjected the bank to criticism and pressure to sacrifice this objective in the pursuit of short-term, more popular goals.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The BSP responded to this challenge by adjusting its monetary and financial policies and striking a delicate balance between restoring order in the foreign exchange market, containing inflationary pressures, and limiting the adverse impact of the crisis on the banking and corporate sectors.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: At no time was the BSP's pursuit of its mission of delivering price stability compromised.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This policy stance was rewarded by the containment of the annual inflation rate to single digit levels even at the height of the crisis.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Belying dire predictions arising from the current increases in world oil prices, the general price level has remained broadly stable, with the inflation rate settling at 5.4 percent in October this year, for a year-to-date average of 7.2 percent.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Economic Growth Performance and Prospects With the economy recovering from the Asian financial storm and with improvement in weather conditions, the Philippines performed better than expected during the first three quarters of this year, with gross national product (GNP) expanding by 3.0 percent in real terms.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The evidence is now clear that industry has begun to recover.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Our growth prospects-especially in terms of our exports-have been helped in large part by the recent marked improvement in global economic and financial conditions.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Of late, some concerns have been raised over the eventual demand slowdown of the US economy.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: However, with adept management especially by the U.S. Fed, we believe that if there is any slowdown at some point, it will be a soft landing.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This could be offset by the strengthening economies of Japan and Europe, as well as of other Asian countries.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Our commitment to price stability has also paid off, in that the resulting low inflation rates have given monetary policy the necessary flexibility in supporting the economic recovery.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Thus, sustained policy adjustments have been made to lower the cost of lending and to improve the availability of credit.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The benchmark 91-day Treasury bill rate was 8.894 percent at the auction held this Monday [29 November 1999], much lower than the 15.3 percent average for 1998.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Last November 3, we trimmed our overnight borrowing rate by 25 basis points to 8.75 percent.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: We assure you that at no point will this compromise our inflation targets.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Facing External Challenges Focusing now on the external sector, risk management will be pursued through the maintenance of an adequate level of foreign exchange reserves and through careful management of our external debt position.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: There continues to be broad stability in the foreign exchange market, with reduced market volatility in 1999 relative to 1997 and 1998.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The improvement should continue as regional factors become more positive and as we continue to see a surplus in our external accounts.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: For the first ten months of 1999, the balance of payments posted a surplus of US$3.4 billion.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This was a significant increase over the US$1.4 billion surplus recorded during the comparable period in 1998.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: In particular, the current account-buttressed by strong exports-has strengthened considerably, registering a surplus of US$3.3 billion in the first eight months from a surplus of only US$14 million during the same period a year ago.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: As a result, we have been able to build up our foreign exchange reserves to a record high of US$14.6 billion as of the end of October.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This is equivalent to 4.2 months of imports of goods and payments of services, and is more than enough to cover our short-term external liabilities, even if these are doubled.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Apart from being a precautionary measure-particularly against the volatile, short-term capital-our reserve build-up program is also a confidence-building measure.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: And let me report to you that our external debt continues to be manageable.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Total foreign indebtedness amounted to US$48.1 billion as of end-June 1999.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: While there has been some increase in the aggregate level, the maturity and creditor profiles have improved.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The share of short-term debt to total debt has declined from 16.4 percent as of end-1992 to 13.6 percent as of the end of the first half of 1999.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Reflecting the judicious sourcing and utilization of foreign borrowings, the debt service burden has dropped through the years: from 17.1 percent in 1992 to 13.5 percent for the first semester of 1999.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This means that-dollar for dollar-we are using less resources to service our foreign obligations.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Financial Sector Reforms The strength of the Philippine financial system effectively shielded the country from the worst impacts of the regional financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This strength is evident in the sustained rise in the total resources of the financial system, underpinned by higher deposits and a stronger capital base, as well as in the improvements in banks' asset quality and compliance with several prudential norms.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Banks' capital adequacy ratio was recorded at 17.6 percent as of end-June.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This was well above the 8 percent standard of the bank for international settlements and the 10 percent statutory requirement.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The real estate exposure of commercial banks dropped to 12.3 percent as of end-June 1999 from 13.1 percent as of end-December 1998.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Meanwhile, the non-performing loans ratio of commercial banks remains manageable at 13.4 percent as of end-September 1999.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Provisioning against loan losses is also adequate, with loan loss reserves equivalent to 5.1 percent of total loans as of end-August 1999.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The non-performing loan (NPL) situation is expected to improve as the economy gains further momentum, resulting in increased lending, and as the effects of lower interest rates and relatively stable exchange rates impact positively on the repayment capability of corporates.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: We have started to see some signs of recovery in bank lending.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: As of end-September, outstanding loans of commercial banks were still down from last year, but the contraction was miniscule, at 0.15 percent, compared to 3.4 percent in August and 4.8 percent in July.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Moreover, outstanding loans registered a 1.1 percent growth on a month-on-month basis.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This follows the 2.0 percent month-on-month increase in August, as well as the increases in June and July.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Some of the important factors that were responsible for the respectable performance of the banking system include: the long history of financial sector reforms, complemented by appropriate and timely implementation by the authorities of regulatory changes before and during the crisis and the vigilant and close supervision by the banks' major stakeholders.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The relatively high equity ratios in Philippine commercial banks have ensured, through stakeholders' rights, that these institutions are managed as sound and profitable entities.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Moreover, the management teams of Philippine banks have had prior experience in dealing with the crisis in the Philippine economy in the early 1980s.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: We also realize the necessity of continuing the structural reform program.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Thus, major reform packages have been submitted to the legislature as amendments to the General Banking Act and the New Central Bank Act.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Broadly speaking, the proposed revisions seek to achieve the following: enhance prudential standards; enhance competition in the banking sector; and promote further the independence of the BSP, particularly its ability to effectively conduct monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Need for Regional Cooperation In my earlier address before the east Asia economic summit, 1 enumerated certain measures that can be adopted at the regional level in order to reduce the chance of future occurrence of a crisis of this magnitude.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Inasmuch as international investor opinion can go a long way towards their adoption, let me take the occasion of this forum to re-enumerate some of the main areas that I feel need to be addressed.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: First, there is need to develop national standards in bank supervision that adhere to international best practices.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Collaborative initiatives along this line would reduce systemic risks in global and regional financial markets.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Key components of these efforts include the development of accessible data banks on the financial system and of high-quality, credible, and transparent reporting and disclosure standards.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: In recognition of the importance of these issues, the BSP has enlisted as one of the first of the IMF member countries to enlist in the IMF Special Data Dissemination System (SDDS).
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: While significant progress in international cooperation has been achieved, this is too important a task to be left to national and international organizations alone.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Active private sector participation is a requirement for success.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Second, the foundation of these efforts to achieve market transparency is the timeliness and accuracy of the data that countries provide the public.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: This is an important issue to be addressed, as the move to increase the accessibility and speed of availability of financial sector data must not be at the expense of accuracy of information.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The risk is that greater openness in information might be attended to by greater volatility in financial markets.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: In this respect, international conferences such as this present gathering serve as important avenues for linking economic decision makers in the region, both from the government and private sectors.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: The challenge is therefore for us to utilize for a such as this to come up with concrete vehicles for government-private sector cooperation.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Third, it is also important to sustain the surveillance process both globally and regionally.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: On a global scale, multilateral institutions need to intensify such a process with the cooperative support of the member nations.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: In this part of the world, regional surveillance should continue under the umbrella of the Asean and the three partners such as China, Japan, and Korea.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Peer review is a very useful mechanism of ensuring regional awareness of key developments and possible roadblocks to economic advance.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Such a surveillance process indeed buys us time to anticipate the emergence of potential instability and the possibility of contagion.
label: negative

title: Keynote Address - Euromoney
text: Thank you and good day.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Chief executives, officers and members of the Philippine Association of Hong Kong (PAHK) and the Philippine Bankers Club of Hong Kong (PBHK), good afternoon: Hong Kong is a very suitable place to discuss our country's monetary and fiscal policies.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: This economic entrepot is a bastion of free market principles; and it therefore serves as a very good setting to present our essentially market-based monetary and fiscal policies.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Our meeting this afternoon is also auspicious because we are at such a decisive juncture of the economic recovery of the Philippines when we begin to look ahead to the challenges of the new millennium.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: But let me preface my remarks this afternoon cautioning you that I will be a one-handed speaker; I will focus on monetary policy and touch on, as necessary, -- in passing -- the acts of the fiscal authorities.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Our responsibilities are sufficiently cut and dried that we can easily discern where one should end and the other should begin.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Current Economic Policy Current macroeconomic policy aims to foster the recovery and shield against domestic and external shocks.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: We have had our learning curve flattened by our interesting experiences in the 1990s including the surge in foreign money in 1993-97, the Tequila effect of 1994-95 and the Tom Yang effect of 1997-99.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: We have kept the course in the two and a half years of the Asian financial crisis.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Monetary policy, in particular, has tried to contain inflation while being flexible enough to enable lower interest rates and a stable exchange rate.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Fiscal policy, on the other hand, continues to aim to stimulate demand through pump-priming without necessarily crowding out private investment.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Recent Economic Results This overall approach produced very good results in 1999, with signs of returning stability and a reviving economy.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Our first three quarter data show that growth has indeed rebounded as agriculture continued to perform strongly and manufacturing made a turnaround.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Inflation was mostly tame because of ample food supply, and the ten-month average inflation rate of 7.2 percent is quite close to the full-year target of 7 percent.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The foreign exchange market was relatively stable in the first three quarters thanks to strong capital inflows.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Bank lending has improved, with a smaller rate of decline in September, and domestic demand strengthened, based on data on imports, car sales and power consumption.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The recovery was due partly to the accommodative policy adopted in the first semester, with measures to help bring down interest rates combined with fiscal pump-priming to stimulate demand.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Monetary stance was afforded greater flexibility because of the subdued inflation trend and the stable foreign exchange market.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Actual monetary growth was also significantly below our target ceilings.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: In a word, conditions were suitable for an easier stance of monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: In the first seven months of 1999, accommodative monetary policy brought down the Reverse Repurchase (RRP) rate to 9 percent in a series of 20 policy rate cuts.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The reserve requirement for banks was also cut by a total of 5 percentage points to 12 percent.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: These measures enabled a decline in both the 91-day Treasury bill rate and bank lending rates.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: As a precautionary measure, the Bangko Sentral also kept base money and reserve money comfortably below the IMF program ceilings.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Meanwhile, expansionary fiscal policy took the form of a P22-billion fiscal stimulus package featured under the 1999 budget.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The package set aside some P14 billion for quick-gestating infrastructure projects and some P8 billion for the acceleration of back payments owed to government contractors.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: It was not entirely smooth sailing, however.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Steering the economic ship through the Charybdis waters of the Asian crisis would be everything but smooth.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Our fiscal authorities also have to deal with revenue shortfalls that threatened the fiscal targets.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: To cope with this, policymakers resorted to virtual belt-tightening by cutting down on non-essential expenditures.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Also, in July, in response to short-term foreign exchange volatility, the Bangko Sentral switched to a neutral monetary stance and kept policy rates steady.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: As external factors such as the weakening Thai baht put pressure on the peso, our neutral stance allowed us to closely study the impact of accommodative policy before deciding to relax the stance further.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Since then, the currency market has re-stabilized, allowing us to make another 25-basis point cut in overnight RRP rates to 8.75 percent effective November 3.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Earlier, we adopted the two-tier approach in our interest rate policy with the end result of achieving lower interest payments of the Bangko Sentral to the banks.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Our aim is to induce banks to lend out their excess liquid funds, instead of parking them in the overnight window of the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: In this way we hope to sustain the improvement in credit growth.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Given these recent economic developments and expected turn of events for the rest of the year and the next, we believe that at this point, our banks, while watching their bottomlines, would need to be more aggressive to protect their present market share of the credit market.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: We have reached the lowest point of the economic cycle, and the only way for the various indicators of demand is up.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The banks, coming from the supply side, should therefore assume the leadership in optimism.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: It is up to them to break the economic stalemate.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: We are, therefore, encouraged by the trend in credit growth.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: More and more banks have started to open their doors to borrowers and investors.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: In due time, we should see the fruits of this positive trend.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: PRESENT AND FUTURE POLICY STANCE The question now is, what is our present stance?
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: And looking ahead, do we need to modify our existing one?
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: To begin with, policy actions in the near future -- such as the decision to further ease the monetary stance -- will indeed depend on the final shape of the economic outlook and on prevailing market conditions.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: For this year, we are targeting an average inflation rate of 7 percent and a GNP growth rate of 3.5 to 4 percent.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Both goals are well within reach.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: In 2000, we expect economic conditions to improve further as the recovery gets underway.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: GDP growth is expected to be stronger, reaching 4 to 5 percent for the year.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Improved agriculture performance and a stable foreign exchange market will help temper inflation in 2000 to an average of 6 to 7 percent.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: There are a number of challenges, of course, and further stimulation may be required to help achieve our broad economic targets.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Over the next few quarters, we will need to continue to nurture the industrial sector and make sure that the turnaround in manufacturing is sustained.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: We would also like to see bank lending strengthen further and convince our local banks to gradually ease their cautious lending stance.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: And most important, we should be able to sustain our actions to intensify our reform agenda in banking, in tax administration as well as in corporate and public governance.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The crisis has taught us to be humble for change.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The November rate cut reflects our belief that there is still some room for monetary easing, particularly since average inflation remains close to the year's overall target.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Monetary policy will continue to support growth while keeping inflation at bay, but further relaxation will be done carefully, in order to sustain the stability of the currency.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: To put it briefly, our monetary stance will remain cautious yet flexible.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The art of monetary policy is essentially a juggling act; you try to keep several balls in the air all at once.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: We try to balance the objective of stimulating the economy with the goals of price stability and exchange rate stability.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: That means taking it one step at a time.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: This means we are not targeting all monetary goals at the same time.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Our monetary instruments are limited.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Similarly, if we may speak about it, fiscal policy is also trying to balance the need to stimulate private demand with the goal of fiscal prudence.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Hence the fiscal stimulus package was combined with some belt-tightening.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Unfortunately, the target budget deficit of P85.3 billion this year may still be exceeded.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Personally, however, I don't think that should be the main concern.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: To my mind, at this early stage of economic recovery, we can afford to accommodate some deficits, at least temporarily, if it would also mean having increased economic activity.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: At any rate, fiscal pressures may begin to ease soon.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Revenue collection is expected to improve as economic growth resumes normal levels.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: More importantly, because of the more favorable economic scenario, there will be less need for government pump-priming.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Therefore, fiscal policy in 2000 will be slightly less expansionary compared to this year.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Instead, the main focus will be on fiscal consolidation.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: As the economy continues to recover, authorities need to focus on sustainability in the long haul.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: For the fiscal sector, the main concern will be balancing the budget in the medium term, say within the next two or three years.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: There are two key strategies to do this.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: First is strengthening the revenue base by improving tax administration.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Higher revenues will reduce the deficit and help pay for priority projects and programs.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The fiscal authorities also plan to rationalize the investment incentive structure by narrowing down the list of tax and duty exemptions.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The second fiscal strategy is expenditure control, or cutting down on non-essential spending.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: With these measures, authorities hope to narrow down the deficit to P62.5 billion in 2000 and hopefully reduce it to zero later on.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Ladies and gentlemen, I took the liberty of venturing onto fiscal ground.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: I wanted to put across at this important gathering the crucial role of a healthy fiscal sector to the conduct of an independent monetary policy.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: To the extent that the fiscal balance is in good shape, the Bangko Sentral can continue focusing on its primary mandate of keeping inflation low and the banking system robust.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: These are the basic elements of vibrant economic growth.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Short of this scenario, however, we might also have to watch for a possible current account deficit and a weak currency.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The curse of high interest rates could very well be again on our laundry list of priority concerns.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: At this point, we have fundamentally put this behind us.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: And the challenge therefore is to ensure that it stays behind us as we strengthen our path to economic recovery.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: THE CHALLENGES AHEAD Part of our job as policymakers is anticipating and responding to emerging issues on both the domestic and external front.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: On the home front, the major concern will be the potential inflationary pressure from rising oil prices and adjustments in wages and transport costs.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Here there should be less concern since we expect that strong agricultural output will help keep down prices for the basic food items, which comprise about 55 percent of the CPI.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: This was what happened in the October inflation data.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead

label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: On the external front, we will need to watch for large fluctuations in the regional currency market.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Further adverse shifts in regional sentiment cannot be ruled out completely yet, and we must remain alert to instability in other Asian countries.
label: negative

text: Over the medium term, market expectations of rising foreign interest rates, particularly in the US, may prompt investors to reallocate their portfolio to foreign assets, thereby affecting short-term movements of the peso and limiting the extent to which interest rates can be brought down.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The main lesson from these challenges that I have outlined to you is the importance of prudent but forward-looking policy that keeps a sharp eye on new developments.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: Monetary policy will continue to be cautious yet flexible, and fiscal policy, as we read it, will focus on consolidation.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: The basic overall thrust is the same: we will try to nurse the recovery but preserve stability and guard against potential shocks to the economy.

label: negative

text: We have already managed to get the train going, and it is running steadily.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: We have done our part and will continue to do so.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: And let me add that I hope that you will come on board and join us as we push full steam ahead into the new millennium.
label: negative

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead
text: And I assure you, the coalfed locomotive is only metaphorical; when you board the Philippine train, it will run on our people's ingenuity and productivity and global competitiveness.

title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Looking Ahead

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The first is a feeling of intimidation.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The second is a feeling of comfort.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And the third is a feeling of luck.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Intimidation, because Gabby leaves behind a performance that is easily the most outstanding among all the past Central Bank Governors of this country.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Comfort, because Gabby has done most of the heavy work of building or remodeling the structures that strengthen the monetary, financial, and banking systems in this country.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: He saved me all that work.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Luck, because while Gabby had to contend with the severe financial storm that hit the Asian region from mid-1997 onward, I take his place when the winds have settled down and the sun is shining again.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: There is actually a fourth feeling, but I saved it for the last.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And that is a feeling of honor.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It is a real privilege to be given the opportunity of - I will not say, following in his footsteps -- but of taking the torch from him and carrying it forward into the future.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Everyone knows that he carried that torch quite a distance during his term.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: As you know, the Management Association of the Philippines named him the Management Man of the year for 1998.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Obviously, the map knows a class act when it sees one.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Now that I've made my confession, I wonder whether Gabby is prepared to confess as to who is the better golfer between us.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And now, for the good news and the bad news.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The bad news is, I have nothing spectacular to say.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: That is unforgivable for a luncheon speaker.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The good news is, I have nothing spectacular to say.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: That is what the business and banking communities want to hear from their central bank Governor.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: No one wants to hear spectacular news from his central bank, just as no one wants to hear it from his doctor.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The Bangko Sentral's overriding concern is stability, just as your doctor's primary concern is your health.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And health and stability have one thing in common: they are no big deal, and you take them for granted, until you stand to lose them.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Then it becomes not only distressing news, but interesting news.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And no one wants to be on the receiving end of that old Chinese curse: "May you live in interesting times."
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Stability has returned, at least to the Philippines.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Interest rates are at pre-crisis low levels; inflation is down; the peso has strengthened from last year's weakness; and the exchange rate has stabilized.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: How could interest rates drop, inflation go down, and the peso strengthen all at the same time?
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Conventional wisdom says that what you achieve with one you lose with the other.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: This phenomenon was not achieved by luck or chance or "tsamba", as critics say, but by adroit management by president Estrada and his economic team.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The stability we enjoy now is due in large part to the success of the BSP in counter- acting speculative attacks on the peso, while by and large allowing the market to set the exchange rate at which the peso will rest without intervention.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: These were, of course, short-term operations.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The more permanent contribution of the BSP to stability against storms were its push for higher bank capitalization requirements, tighter disclosure rules and reporting requirements for bank auditors, new provisioning for loan loss reserves, and the improved quality of bank management and supervision.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: These and other bank reform measures gave our banking system a sturdiness that the institutions in the neighboring countries did not have.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Thus, when the financial storm huffed and puffed, the financial houses in other countries were blown away, while ours remained standing.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Some are saying that the Philippines was not as badly affected by the Asian crisis as our neighbors because we hadn't grown as fast as they did to begin with.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: I believe otherwise.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The others had grown more rapidly than we did, but on a weaker financial, structural, and regulatory base.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Our foundations and our structures were stronger.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The return of relative tranquility and the settling of financial markets do not give the BSP any time or space to rest.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It must remain alert and flexible.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It must continually scan the local, global and regional environments for signs of disturbances, and respond in advance or at least on time.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: However, the BSP now also has more productive time for participating in the strengthening of the Philippine economy.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The economic vision of the Estrada administration aims for three broad objectives: stability, growth and equity.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Stability is both political and economic: it ranges from peace and order, internal and external security, and a functioning justice system to minimal movements in prices, interest rates, and exchange rates.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Growth is the continuing and sustainable rise in output, income and employment.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And equity is the widening of the sharing of the fruits of growth, with preferential attention to the poor.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Growth is the business of the private sector working in a free market, with the government supporting it with basic services, infrastructure, and a sound policy and regulatory environment.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Equity results from a whole host of factors, including the efficiency of the investment and labor markets, the profile of investments made, the structure of investment incentives, the pattern of government expenditures, tax laws, labor laws, and the like.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The overriding day-to-day responsibility of the Bangko Sentral is stability.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It must keep the inflation rate as low as feasible, and it must balance and fine-tune the relationship between interest rates and the exchange rate.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Any instability in their behavior, or uncertainties with respect to their future - such as rapid inflation, or disorderly movements in interest rates and in exchange rates - either discourage investments or distort their patterns, away from the long-term and into the short-term, away from fixed assets and into more liquid assets, away from production and into speculation.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: In other words, by acting as the guardian of stability, the BSP provides the right environment for investments to build productive capacity - and thus expand output, income and employment -- and for businesses to operate efficiently.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: To repeat, a stable environment is something nobody notices but which everybody thrives in.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Disturb the stability, and everybody scrambles either for cover or for quick deals, to avoid getting killed or to make a killing.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: But one thing many people do not realize.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The preservation of stability is different from the promotion of growth.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP has the tools of monetary policy for preserving stability.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: But, contrary to what many may think, monetary policy does not have the tools for promoting growth.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It can generate the proper environment conducive to growth, but it cannot itself promote growth.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: These tools for growth are in the hands of the private sector and of the fiscal sector.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Monetary policy is like a string: it can be used for pulling back, but not for pushing forward.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And a central bank governor is like a car driver with one foot: he can step on the brake, but not on the accelerator.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It is the consumers, investors and the government who have their feet on the accelerator.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: If they overspeed (and risk inflation), the Bangko Sentral can step on the brake.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: But if they do not step deeply enough on the accelerator (and risk a slowdown), the BSP cannot force them.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: To change metaphors, the central bank can lead businessmen and bankers to water, but it can't force them to drink.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: I think we have all seen this phenomenon in recent periods.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Interest rates kept falling, but banks were not keen on lending, and businesses were unable to borrow or hesitate to borrow.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: With its tools of monetary policy, the BSP can provide stability, but it cannot push growth.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It cannot push a string.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It has no foot to step on the accelerator.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: That is the very nature of central banking.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: But the maintenance of stability in itself is a tall order.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We could maintain our internal house in order, but if a storm comes from overseas, we have to waive our right to sleep.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Just watch Gabby Singson's face in the next few weeks.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Watch him look younger and younger.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: And watch me as well grow, well, younger and younger also.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: That is because I thrive on challenges, and challenges keep me young.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Many of you may be asking what to expect of my stewardship of the BSP.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: My answer is simple: continuing monetary stability and continuing banking reform.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP will strive to maintain domestic price stability.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: If liquidity from other sources threatens to heat up domestic price levels, in other words, inflation, the BSP will counteract it.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We will see to it that enough liquidity is provided to satisfy the operations and growth requirements of business, but with a wary eye on the inflation rate and on the exchange rate.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We will work towards the lowest interest rates possible, consistent with keeping the real interest rate positive and without jeopardizing the stability of domestic price levels and of the peso's exchange rate.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We will fine-tune and balance the movements of domestic interest rates and the exchange rate and keep them within a general band, to maintain a stable environment.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We will balance the levels of domestic with foreign interest rates, to prevent speculative capital movements whether inward or outward.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We will maintain the present free market in foreign exchange.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The foreign exchange rate will be essentially market-determined, under a floating rate system.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Any intervention by the BSP in the FOREX market will be temporary and will be aimed at minimizing the volatility of the exchange rate, not at setting its level or its trend.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We will strive to build up further our international reserves, beyond the present record levels.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The higher our reserves, the greater our ability to withstand shocks, and the stronger the confidence of the public in the health of the economy.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: One thing the BSP will not do: it will not resort to capital controls, or to regulating the inward and outward movement of financial flows.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: There are other defenses possible against the in-and-out movements of so-called hot money, which generally comes in to buy shares and other assets, and then disposes of them and leaves.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Capital controls are not the answer.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Total foreign exchange controls are worse, and will not be adopted.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: They distort investments and, as our history shows, they simply breed corruption.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: A Russian American songstress once said: "I've been rich and I've been poor.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Rich is better."
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: with respect to our foreign exchange market, and indeed of our economy in general, we can also say, "we've been controlled and we've been free.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Free is better."
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: In addition to adopting these monetary guidelines, the BSP will continue to pursue its program of institutional and structural reform in the banking system.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: This is to enhance the strength of the banking system and its capability to serve the financial requirements of our development, and to withstand the kind of shocks that it experienced with the Asian crisis.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP will continue to upgrade its monitoring and supervision systems, tightening prudential practices, building strong risk management mechanisms, improving problem recognition processes and capabilities of banks, and providing training to bank examiners and reviewers of the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP will continue to support certain bills in the legislative pipeline.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: These include bills to amend the General Banking Act and the New Central Bank act.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: These amendments aim at strengthening further our regulatory oversight, raise prudential standards to international norms, foster greater competition, and enhance the supervisory capability and independence of the Bangko Sentral.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP will foster a more efficient, strong, and stable financial system in a deregulated environment.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: These efforts include: initiatives to further increase the minimum capitalization of banks; to provide incentives for mergers; and to liberalize the equity and citizenship structure of banks.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The fact that our banking system is already well capitalized has made them structurally better prepared to cope with crises.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Our banks are among the region's highest capitalized banks.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Its capital adequacy ratio, or CAR, was 17.65% in 1998, well above global standards.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: On the other hand, most of our banks remain small by regional standards.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Bank mergers will further strengthen the banking system.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP will continue to extend short-term incentives to banks that plan to merge.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: As the promoters of "Godzilla, the movie," contend, size does matter.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Big banks possess financial strength and are able to meet the needs of large technology investments, a more demanding customer base, and more open markets.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: They are able to compete more aggressively without compromising their financial soundness.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Opening up our banking sector to the entry of more foreign banks will enhance competitive conditions locally, induce mergers and consolidations, and serve the legitimate credit needs of business and personal borrowers better.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: In fact, I believe that the competition to be encouraged by these trends will so strengthen even local banks that we will someday see a Filipino regional bank emerge, and beyond that a Filipino bank with trans-national reach.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP - in coordination with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the department of finance, private institutions such as the Philippine stock exchange, and business organizations such as those present here today - will push vigorously for the rapid development of the local capital market.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: These include the design and introduction of new financial instruments for use in trading and investments, and the formation of various types of investor institutions and funds to harness savings and channel them into investments.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We aim to attain and eventually surpass the levels of sophistication of the capital markets of our most advanced neighbors.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The BSP will also support the lowering of over-all credit costs to local borrowers, in order to stimulate new investments and expansions of operations.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: It will support the progressive lowering and ultimate disappearance of the gross receipts tax imposed on banks and financial institutions.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: In sum, the BSP will pursue a two-fold mission.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The first is to guard and maintain stability.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: The second is to lead and drive the development of the banking and financial system towards greater strength, sophistication, competitiveness, and responsiveness to the requirements of the country's growth.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: Globalization, liberalization, and technological developments are going on at a rapid pace, and confront us with threats as well as opportunities.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We must be fast enough to keep up with that pace, strong enough to meet the threats, and smart enough to avail of the opportunities.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: At the beginning, I spoke of escaping a baptism of fire here.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth
text: We are told by scripture of a baptism of water and a baptism of the spirit.
label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth

label: negative

title: Continuity and Focus: Pathways to Sustained Growth

text: Since my last briefing here at this same venue approximately a year ago, so many important developments have occurred.
